template.title: SAP Business One Standard Semantic Template (SQL Server)
template.description: Standard SAP Business One tables and relationships for sales, purchasing, inventory, production, and finance. Trace source document types and composite keys, and distinguish posting, document, and creation dates as well as quantity, currency, and amount granularity. This template contains no company database connection, workspace information, or customer-specific metrics. Verify the target database tables, columns, and version before importing. Inventory costs, production order processes, and historical balances still require verification against the target company database and SAP standard reports.

crd1.description: Business partner address master data; records the address, city, region, tax and contact details of a customer or supplier.

dln1.description: Corresponds to DocumentLine in DeliveryNotes.DocumentLines; the physical table is DLN1. The same shared type maps to different tables under other parent documents. document line granularity, primary key (DocEntry, LineNum). Sales delivery documents; invoicing and returns are subsequent or associated processes, and the delivery amount cannot be directly named as revenue. Amount basis: LineTotal is local currency line amount excluding tax, currency is the company database OADM local currency (OADM.MainCurncy); TotalSumSy is system currency line amount, currency is OADM.SysCurrncy; foreign currency document TotalFrgn uses header DocCur (ODLN.DocCur), and ODLN.DocEntry is related to this line DocEntry. this line Currency is the price currency, not the unified currency for all line amount. The amounts across currency foreign currency are summarized separately; the total amount in the first section cannot be directly equivalent to line amount excluding tax. For service lines, current open amounts are OpenSum/OpenSumFC/OpenSumSys. TreeType identifies BOM roles. Use the project and sales employee saved on the line, without substituting header or current master values.

AcctCode.description: document line account code, associated with OACT.AcctCode; the service line can explain the business through the account and description. The presence of an account code does not prove that the document has generated accounting postings or that the amount has been recognized as revenue.

BaseEntry.description: Marketing document source internal key; target DocEntry is joined only if the source type matches.

BaseLine.description: Marketing document source line number; forms a source triplet with BaseEntry and BaseType. References the stored LineNum of the source document, not the source collection API array index or UI display order.

BaseType.description: Only the this line direct source type is recorded; it must be connected together with BaseEntry and BaseLine, and the direct edge cannot be made according to the flow chart. SQL predicates use the source object type numeric code, never an API entity name; supported direct sources follow the declared relationships.

Currency.description: currency for this line price is used to interpret price fields such as Price; it cannot be used to interpret LineTotal or TotalSumSy, which use OADM.MainCurncy and OADM.SysCurrncy respectively. foreign currency document line amount TotalFrgn is explained by ODLN.DocCur, line price currency and document currency must be read separately.

DiscPrcnt.description: The current discount percentage of document line is separate from the entire order discount.

DocDate.description: Business posting date; used with document date, due date and creation date respectively.

DocEntry.description: The internal key of the corresponding table header; and LineNum constitute the primary key of this table row.

Dscription.description: The material or service description saved by document line reflects the historical content of the document and cannot be replaced by the current material master data name; the service line belonging to ODLN.DocType=S does not have ItemCode.

FreeTxt.description: document line Free text or remarks.

GrossBuyPr.description: The base price used to calculate this line gross profit can be taken from the price list, latest purchase price, material cost, etc. based on gross profit settings. It is not a fixed actual purchase cost, nor can it be directly regarded as the inventory delivery cost; currency and the pricing unit need to be verified with applicable documents and settings.

GTotal.displayName: Total Line Tax Including Tax (Local Currency)
GTotal.description: document line is the tax-included total after taking line discounts into account, and is used separately from the tax-exclusive LineTotal series; it is not presumed that all header discounts, fees or prepayments have been allocated, nor is it directly equivalent to the total document header total. currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy. Do not press DocCur or line Currency to assign currency to this column. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

GTotalFC.displayName: Total Line Tax Including Tax (Foreign Currency)
GTotalFC.description: document line is the tax-included total after taking line discounts into account, and is used separately from the tax-exclusive LineTotal series; it is not presumed that all header discounts, fees or prepayments have been allocated, nor is it directly equivalent to the total document header total. Normal foreign currency documents interpret currency according to the ODLN.DocCur they belong to. This mapping is a combined interpretation of the field family and the document currency rules; the line price Currency cannot be used instead, and cross-documents must be grouped according to currency. The FC column of the local currency document may not be applicable, and the business amount cannot be determined to be zero due to zero or null values. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

GTotalSC.displayName: Total Line Tax Including Tax (System Currency)
GTotalSC.description: document line is the tax-included total after taking line discounts into account, and is used separately from the tax-exclusive LineTotal series; it is not presumed that all header discounts, fees or prepayments have been allocated, nor is it directly equivalent to the total document header total. currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, using the saved amount and not recalculating according to the current exchange rate. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

InvQty.description: The quantity represented by inventory unit of measure; unlike Quantity, whether an inventory movement is formed is still determined by the document and mark.

ItemCode.description: Material identification; identical materials cannot be proven to belong to the same order, work order, or source line.

LineNum.description: Participates in the composite primary key and BaseLine source connection; not the interface sort number VisOrder. Line numbers need not be contiguous and cannot be reconstructed from API collection array indexes.

LineStatus.description: O=Open; C=Close. Closing and canceling have different meanings; they are handled explicitly based on business issues, and valid and canceled documents cannot be mixed.

LineTotal.description: Excluding tax local currency line amount, currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy; does not change the Currency or header DocCur to currency basis. It is not equal to the posted amount of inventory valuation, nor can it be directly equal to the total amount of the document header, ignoring taxes, discounts and rounding differences.

NoInvtryMv.description: There is no inventory quantity change flag, and the presence of the field does not mean that this type of document will necessarily cause inventory movement. Its actual effect must be verified based on the document role, source and applicable settings. Inventory value or accounting impact cannot be inferred based on this field alone.

NumPerMsr.description: The unit of measure conversion value saved in this document line; historical analysis must not be directly overwritten with the current material master data conversion.

ObjType.description: The object type belonging to the current document cannot replace the BaseType explanation source.

OpenInvQty.description: Quantity of open expressed as inventory UoM; used for comparison with basis in stock, still in current status.

OpenQty.description: The current remaining quantity of open; it is not the balance at any historical point in time, nor can it be generally equal to the quantity that has not been shipped or invoiced.

Price.description: DI API defines Price as the unit price before tax; the database reference in this table is only marked as price, and the meaning after discount must be interpreted in conjunction with PriceBefDi, DiscPrcnt and pricing rules. It cannot be claimed that this table dictionary has directly stated it. The price currency is taken from this line Currency, and is interpreted according to the this line transaction pricing unit; it is checked with UomEntry/UomCode/unitMsr, UseBaseUn and NumPerMsr, and is not priced according to inventory UoM by default. It is not directly added as the business amount, nor can it be used as the inventory valuation unit price.

PriceAfVAT.displayName: Unit Price Including Tax After Line Discount
PriceAfVAT.description: The tax-included unit price after applying this line discount is not the tax-included price before discount. The price currency is taken from this line Currency, and is interpreted according to the this line transaction pricing unit; it is checked with UomEntry/UomCode/unitMsr, UseBaseUn and NumPerMsr, and is not priced according to inventory UoM by default. It is used separately with the pre-tax price, pre-discount price and line amount, and does not overwrite the historical value with the current tax rate and discount recalculation.

PriceBefDi.displayName: Unit Price Before Discount And Tax
PriceBefDi.description: The pre-tax unit price before this line discount is applied; this table column definition and the SAP unit price rule jointly determine the basis. The price currency is taken from this line Currency, and is interpreted according to the this line transaction pricing unit; it is checked with UomEntry/UomCode/unitMsr, UseBaseUn and NumPerMsr, and is not priced according to inventory UoM by default. Use separately with the discounted price and saved line amount.

Quantity.description: The quantity of sales or purchasing units in a document; the unit must be unified before totaling across documents and materials, and is not directly equivalent to the inventory UoM quantity.

Rate.description: document line currency is converted to exchange rate for company local currency.

ShipDate.description: this line delivery date field; different from the header posting date, whether actual delivery must be combined with the document type.

TargetType.description: The object type of the subsequent target document.

TotalFrgn.description: foreign currency basis of line amount; foreign currency documents are interpreted by belonging to ODLN.DocCur, this line DocEntry is associated with ODLN.DocEntry, and cross-documents are grouped by DocCur. Row Currency only represents the price currency, and does not assign currency to this column accordingly; LineTotal is used for local currency documents, and the business amount is not judged to be zero based on the zero or empty value of this column.

TotalSumSy.description: system currency basis and currency of line amount take the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy; it is not the unit price, the row Currency or header DocCur is not used as currency, and the saved amount is not recalculated according to the current exchange rate.

unitMsr.description: this line unit of measure display name; used to explain Quantity.

UomCode.description: this line unit of measure code; different unit quantities cannot be added directly before consistency is verified.

UomEntry.description: this line unit of measure mark; should be used together with UomCode and the conversion value saved in the document.

UseBaseUn.description: this line inventory unit of measure mark; combined with Quantity, InvQty and unit code explanation.

VatSum.description: document line total tax, including standard tax and applicable equalization tax, can be manually adjusted; unlike LineVat series net tax, the saved value is not overwritten by the price multiplied by the tax rate. currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy. Do not press DocCur or line Currency to assign currency to this column. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

VatSumFrgn.description: document line total tax, including standard tax and applicable equalization tax, can be manually adjusted; unlike LineVat series net tax, the saved value is not overwritten by the price multiplied by the tax rate. Normal foreign currency documents interpret currency according to the ODLN.DocCur they belong to. This mapping is a combined interpretation of the field family and the document currency rules; the line price Currency cannot be used instead, and cross-documents must be grouped according to currency. The FC column of the local currency document may not be applicable, and the business amount cannot be determined to be zero due to zero or null values. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

VatSumSy.description: document line total tax, including standard tax and applicable equalization tax, can be manually adjusted; unlike LineVat series net tax, the saved value is not overwritten by the price multiplied by the tax rate. currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, and uses the saved amount, and does not recalculate according to the current exchange rate. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

VisOrder.description: The display order of document line in the interface.

WhsCode.description: Business lines correspond to warehouses; warehouses, storage locations and materials have different granularities.

Project.description: Project code saved on this line; joins OPRJ.PrjCode. Do not default to the header project or remove historical lines based on current project activity or validity. Distinguish an empty code from an unmatched project master record.

SlpCode.description: Sales employee code saved on this line; joins OSLP.SlpCode. Keep it separate from the header sales employee and the current customer master salesperson; do not force them to agree. Null, unassigned and unmatched values do not identify a default employee.

TreeType.description: Document line BOM role: N=not a BOM, A=assembly, S=sales BOM, I=sales BOM component, P=production BOM, T=template. Distinguishes parent and component roles; it does not define parent/child line keys or justify deleting all components or summing parent and component quantities indiscriminately. Interpret prices and quantities using actual roles and settings; investigate unknown values separately.

OpenSum.description: Only applicable to service document lines with parent ODLN.DocType=S. The current open business amount for this line, interpreted separately from LineStatus; OpenQty is not a monetary substitute. It is not a cash receipt, document receivable balance or historical aging value; do not overwrite it with quantity times current price. Currency comes from OADM.MainCurncy in the same company database.

OpenSumFC.description: Only applicable to service document lines with parent ODLN.DocType=S. The current open business amount for this line, interpreted separately from LineStatus; OpenQty is not a monetary substitute. It is not a cash receipt, document receivable balance or historical aging value; do not overwrite it with quantity times current price. Verify foreign-currency applicability and currency against the parent document, not the line price Currency; aggregate different currencies separately.

OpenSumSys.description: Only applicable to service document lines with parent ODLN.DocType=S. The current open business amount for this line, interpreted separately from LineStatus; OpenQty is not a monetary substitute. It is not a cash receipt, document receivable balance or historical aging value; do not overwrite it with quantity times current price. Currency comes from OADM.SysCurrncy in the same company database.

GTotalFC.description: Saved gross row amount in the stated currency; not the document total and not an extra amount to add to the header.

GTotalSC.description: Saved gross row amount in the stated currency; not the document total and not an extra amount to add to the header.

OpenSum.description: Current open amount for this service document row in its stated currency; not an unpaid balance, historical aging, or inventory quantity.

OpenSumFC.description: Current open amount for this service document row in its stated currency; not an unpaid balance, historical aging, or inventory quantity.

OpenSumSys.description: Current open amount for this service document row in its stated currency; not an unpaid balance, historical aging, or inventory quantity.

Project.description: Project code saved on this record, linked to OPRJ. Keep header and row projects separate.

SlpCode.description: Sales/Purchasing employee code saved on this record, linked to OSLP.SlpCode. Distinct from document owner and requester; do not replace with the current vendor assignment.

TreeType.description: N=not BOM, A=assembly, S=sales BOM, I=sales BOM component, P=production, T=template. Use saved row type without inventing hierarchy keys or dropping components.

OcrCode.description: Distribution rule code on this row, linked to OOCR.OcrCode. Not a single cost center; finance owns allocation details.

OcrCode2.description: Distribution rule code on this row, linked to OOCR.OcrCode. Not a single cost center; finance owns allocation details.

OcrCode3.description: Distribution rule code on this row, linked to OOCR.OcrCode. Not a single cost center; finance owns allocation details.

OcrCode4.description: Distribution rule code on this row, linked to OOCR.OcrCode. Not a single cost center; finance owns allocation details.

OcrCode5.description: Distribution rule code on this row, linked to OOCR.OcrCode. Not a single cost center; finance owns allocation details.

ige1.description: For inventory delivery note details, the only granularity is DocEntry+LineNum; the same material in the same document can appear in multiple lines, the DocNum+ItemCode grouping cannot represent the original line, and AVG(StockPrice) cannot be called the original line unit price. The production source is BaseType=202, BaseEntry points to OWOR, and BaseLine points to the WOR1 component; the business classification is confirmed by user or workspace. The actual date is OIGE.DocDate, and the issue history is not truncated based on the work order date. The signed posting amount of the warehouse journal comes from OIVL.SumStock, which is related by TransType=60, CreatedBy=DocEntry, DocLineNum=LineNum and aggregated by the issue line; this table StockSum is used to check the inventory amount of document line, and this table cannot be named as a valuation journal. The premise of normal perpetual inventory cost and currency are determined by OADM.ContInvnt and MainCurncy, and inventory UoM is interpreted according to historical UseBaseUn, NumPerMsr and unitMsr. Non-inventory expenses may have no OIVL valuation; missing valuation does not confirm zero cost.

BaseEntry.description: Matching source table DocEntry; not the source display order number.

BaseLine.description: When BaseType=202, it is jointly connected with BaseEntry to WOR1.DocEntry and LineNum; the goods issue line itself LineNum is not the work order component line number. When the source line is empty, negative, or has no match, the exception or special source is retained without guessing the material code.

BaseType.description: Explain the source together with BaseEntry and BaseLine; when special values have no source, they must not be forced to be associated.

Currency.description: DI API is defined as the price currency used by document line. This definition does not alone prove that StockPrice, StockSum, or other inventory valuation fields use the same currency; each field basis should be verified separately.

DiscPrcnt.description: The current discount percentage of document line is separate from the entire order discount.

DocDate.description: The line date field can be NULL; the actual occurrence date of IGE1 should be obtained from the corresponding document header OIGE.DocDate through DocEntry. It cannot be judged that there is no transaction because the line date is empty. posting date and CreateDate systems creation date are explained separately.

DocEntry.description: It forms the row primary key with LineNum and is associated with this document header.

Dscription.description: document line description, which may be different from the current master data name.

FromWhsCod.description: When describing the source warehouse in applicable scenarios such as allocation, it should not be confused with WhsCode.

InvQty.description: Inventory unit of measure quantity; aggregates all transactions by issuing row before comparing with valuation transactions OutQty-InQty. When the unit name is UseBaseUn=Y and NumPerMsr=1, the historical non-empty unitMsr is taken; in other cases, the historical inventory UoM mapping must be verified. The unit cannot be inferred based solely on Quantity=InvQty or the current master data; cross-materials and units cannot be directly merged, and zero quantity cannot be used for division.

ItemCode.description: ItemType needs to be combined to identify the record type; resource rows cannot be unconditionally associated with material master data.

ItemType.description: 4 is the material; IGE1/IGN1 also allows 290 resources, and is limited to 4 when associated with OITM.

LineNum.description: It forms the primary key with DocEntry; it is not the display sequence VisOrder, nor the source row BaseLine.

LineStatus.description: O=Open; C=Close. Closing and canceling have different meanings; they are handled explicitly based on business issues, and valid and canceled documents cannot be mixed.

LineTotal.description: DI API is defined as the tax-exclusive amount of this line; it has its own responsibilities with StockSum, StockValue and the valuation posting amount. The equal values ​​of some issue lines do not constitute a universal identity, and the price cannot be multiplied by Quantity or LineTotal can be used to replace the deposited posted amount.

NumPerMsr.description: DI API is defined as the material quantity contained in each unit of measure, and is matched with unitMsr and UseBaseUn; historical document values are retained and do not need to be overwritten by the current master data ratio.

ObjType.description: The object type of the current document itself is not the source document type BaseType.

OpenInvQty.description: The current open quantity represented by inventory unit of measure.

OpenQty.description: The number of lines that are still outstanding; it is not the balance at any historical point, nor can it ignore the status of closing, cancellation, etc.

Price.description: DI API is clearly the pre-tax material price; it is still the document price and cannot be directly equivalent to the inventory valuation layer cost or historical posting price.

Quantity.description: Use document line unit of measure; confirm that the units are consistent before summarizing across documents.

StockPrice.description: Official Inventory Price, historical inventory unit price saved by DocEntry+LineNum. In normal inventory material issuance, the applicable conditions for currency and the denominator must obtain the field values of this record respectively: ① Press ItemCode to read OITM.InvntItem, which must be Y (inventory material); ② Read OADM.ContInvnt, it must be Y, and read OADM.MainCurncy; ③ Read this line UseBaseUn, NumPerMsr and history unitMsr, must be Y, 1 and not empty. When the first two items are true, currency takes the company local currency OADM.MainCurncy; when all three items are true, the denominator takes the historical inventory UoM, which can be interpreted as local currency/the inventory UoM; this is the basis for combination rather than the field-by-field clear text of SDK. ItemType=4 only represents the material. The existence of associated valuation, other conditions being met, or equal values ​​cannot replace OITM.InvntItem. When the conditions are not verified or the materials are not in stock, the original value is retained and the unconfirmed basis is stated; when UseBaseUn=N, the price denominator and conversion rules still need to be verified. OIGE.DocCur and IGE1.Currency cannot replace the stock local currency source. The details retain row granularity; cross-row AVG only records the arithmetic average of the unit price, not the original row price or comprehensive cost. Named separately with CalcPrice, amount/quantity conversion price; resources, revaluation, negative inventory adjustment and special reversal are separately reviewed. The comprehensive conversion unit cost must be the same as basis total cost/total inventory quantity.

StockSum.description: The official Stock Sum and document line inventory amounts are different from the total cost of goods sold value of StockValue and the tax-exclusive amount of LineTotal. Normal perpetual inventory material issuance is interpreted as local currency OADM.MainCurncy, and cannot be marked by OIGE.DocCur or IGE1.Currency. It must be checked with the correctly associated valuation transaction sign SumStock; unverified business cannot automatically apply the plus or minus sign formula, and it will not automatically fall back to this field when the valuation is missing.

StockValue.description: The official definition is Total COGS Value (total cost of goods sold value), not SumStock inventory value change or StockSum document line inventory total. In the production issue, this field can be 0 but the actual inventory posting is non-zero; zero cost cannot be inferred from 0 or NULL, nor can it be automatically replenished with LineTotal.

TotalFrgn.description: foreign currency line amount; cannot be mixed with local currency amount for summing.

TotalSumSy.description: document line system currency amount; do not mix with local currency, foreign currency amount.

unitMsr.description: The unit of measure name saved by this line is used for Quantity. When UseBaseUn=Y and NumPerMsr=1, it can also be used as the historical unit name of this line inventory quantity InvQty; the unit can be marked only if it is not empty. Unit names or abbreviations do not have a unified physical meaning. They must be displayed as they are without unit definition or workspace confirmation mapping, and cannot be translated, expanded or converted by themselves. The current name OITM cannot overwrite the history; when UseBaseUn=N it cannot be directly used as inventory UoM.

UomCode.description: document line unit code snapshot.

UomEntry.displayName: Row Unit Of Measure Internal Identification
UomEntry.description: Associated with OUOM; special values such as manual units need to be confirmed.

UseBaseUn.description: inventory UoM marks Y/N. Official shipping window description: When Y, line Quantity is issued as inventory UoM, Items per Unit is 1; when N, the actual inventory quantity is converted according to lines Quantity and NumPerMsr. Combining the this line historical unitMsr and NumPerMsr interpretation units, it cannot be inferred just because Quantity=InvQty.

VisOrder.description: Interface sorting field; cannot replace LineNum as the business-related key.

WhsCode.description: this line inventory warehouse; transfer needs to read out the warehouse at the same time.

Project.description: Project code stored on this document line; interpret it separately from the header project and current item master data.

ign1.description: Each combination of DocEntry and LineNum is in one line; when BaseType=202, it belongs to the production order; production storage may also mean that components are returned or disassembled and stored in storage, and cannot all be counted as finished product output.

BaseEntry.description: Matching source table DocEntry; not the source display order number.

BaseLine.description: The matching source line LineNum cannot be replaced by the current LineNum.

BaseType.description: Explain the source together with BaseEntry and BaseLine; when special values have no source, they must not be forced to be associated.

Currency.description: currency context for the price field.

DiscPrcnt.description: The current discount percentage of document line is separate from the entire order discount.

DocDate.description: The line date field can be NULL; the actual occurrence date of IGN1 should be obtained from the corresponding document header OIGN.DocDate through DocEntry. It cannot be judged that there is no transaction because the line date is empty. posting date and CreateDate systems creation date are explained separately.

DocEntry.description: It forms the row primary key with LineNum and is associated with this document header.

Dscription.description: document line description, which may be different from the current master data name.

FromWhsCod.description: When describing the source warehouse in applicable scenarios such as allocation, it should not be confused with WhsCode.

InvQty.description: The official definition is inventory UoM quantity; for inventory quantity comparison, the basis is used first and the actual unit is verified.

ItemCode.description: ItemType needs to be combined to identify the record type; resource rows cannot be unconditionally associated with material master data.

ItemType.description: 4 is the material; IGE1/IGN1 also allows 290 resources, and is limited to 4 when associated with OITM.

LineNum.description: It forms the primary key with DocEntry; it is not the display sequence VisOrder, nor the source row BaseLine.

LineStatus.description: O=Open; C=Close. Closing and canceling have different meanings; they are handled explicitly based on business issues, and valid and canceled documents cannot be mixed.

LineTotal.description: DI API is clearly the total amount of this line excluding tax; currency must be interpreted in conjunction with the document fields and is not directly equivalent to the inventory posting amount.

NumPerMsr.description: DI API is defined as the material quantity contained in each unit of measure, and is matched with unitMsr and UseBaseUn; historical document values are retained and do not need to be overwritten by the current master data ratio.

ObjType.description: The object type of the current document itself is not the source document type BaseType.

OpenInvQty.description: The current open quantity represented by inventory unit of measure.

OpenQty.description: The number of lines that are still outstanding; it is not the balance at any historical point, nor can it ignore the status of closing, cancellation, etc.

Price.description: DI API is clearly the pre-tax material price; it is still the document price and cannot be directly equivalent to the inventory valuation layer cost or historical posting price.

Quantity.description: Use document line unit of measure; confirm that the units are consistent before summarizing across documents.

StockPrice.description: Official Inventory Price; document line existing inventory unit price. The unit price calculated by the IVL1.CalcPrice valuation layer, the original price of OIVL.Price, and the converted unit price obtained by dividing the posted amount by the inventory quantity are displayed separately; the rounding accuracy of the amount and price can make them different. Multi-line summary cannot be simply AVG unit price; conversion can be based on total cost/total quantity only after checking the same currency and quantity units.

StockSum.description: The official definition is Stock Sum; used to check the inventory amount of document line, which is different from the total cost of goods sold value of StockValue and the tax-exclusive amount of LineTotal. The production issue must be checked with the signed SumStock of the associated valuation transaction, and cannot be set as a general posting formula or an automatic fallback value when there is a missing valuation without verification by the target business.

StockValue.description: The official definition is Total COGS Value (total cost of goods sold value), not SumStock inventory value change or StockSum document line inventory total. In the production issue, this field can be 0 but the actual inventory posting is non-zero; zero cost cannot be inferred from 0 or NULL, nor can it be automatically replenished with LineTotal.

TotalFrgn.description: foreign currency line amount; cannot be mixed with local currency amount for summing.

TotalSumSy.description: document line system currency amount; do not mix with local currency, foreign currency amount.

TranType.displayName: Production Receipt Completion or Rejection Type
TranType.description: Database values are C=Complete and R=Reject. DI API enumeration values 0/1 must not be used directly as TranType filters. Product receipts, component returns, and disassembly roles still require separate classification.

unitMsr.description: this line unit of measure display name; used to explain Quantity.

UomCode.description: document line unit code snapshot.

UomEntry.displayName: Row Unit Of Measure Internal Identification
UomEntry.description: Associated with OUOM; special values such as manual units need to be confirmed.

UseBaseUn.description: DI API indicates whether to use the basic unit defined by the system; differences in units such as boxes and pieces must be explained together with NumPerMsr and line units.

VisOrder.description: Interface sorting field; cannot replace LineNum as the business-related key.

WhsCode.description: this line inventory warehouse; transfer needs to read out the warehouse at the same time.

Project.description: Project code stored on this document line; interpret it separately from the header project and current item master data.

inv1.description: Corresponds to DocumentLine in Invoices.DocumentLines; the physical table is INV1. The same shared type maps to different tables under other parent documents. document line granularity, primary key (DocEntry, LineNum). Receivable invoicing documents; including reserved invoices, must be distinguished by isIns, and it cannot be assumed that inventory movement occurs for each document. Amount basis: LineTotal is local currency line amount excluding tax, currency is the company database OADM local currency (OADM.MainCurncy); TotalSumSy is system currency line amount, currency is OADM.SysCurrncy; foreign currency document TotalFrgn uses header DocCur (OINV.DocCur), and OINV.DocEntry is related to this line DocEntry. this line Currency is the price currency, not the unified currency for all line amount. The amounts across currency foreign currency are summarized separately; the total amount in the first section cannot be directly equivalent to line amount excluding tax. For service lines, current open amounts are OpenSum/OpenSumFC/OpenSumSys. TreeType identifies BOM roles. Use the project and sales employee saved on the line, without substituting header or current master values.

AcctCode.description: document line account code, associated with OACT.AcctCode; the service line can explain the business through the account and description. The presence of an account code does not prove that the document has generated accounting postings or that the amount has been recognized as revenue.

BaseEntry.description: Marketing document source internal key; target DocEntry is joined only if the source type matches.

BaseLine.description: Marketing document source line number; forms a source triplet with BaseEntry and BaseType. References the stored LineNum of the source document, not the source collection API array index or UI display order.

BaseType.description: Only the this line direct source type is recorded; it must be connected together with BaseEntry and BaseLine, and the direct edge cannot be made according to the flow chart. SQL predicates use the source object type numeric code, never an API entity name; supported direct sources follow the declared relationships.

Currency.description: currency for this line price is used to interpret price fields such as Price; it cannot be used to interpret LineTotal or TotalSumSy, which use OADM.MainCurncy and OADM.SysCurrncy respectively. foreign currency document line amount TotalFrgn is explained by OINV.DocCur, line price currency and document currency must be read separately.

DiscPrcnt.description: The current discount percentage of document line is separate from the entire order discount.

DocDate.description: Business posting date; used with document date, due date and creation date respectively.

DocEntry.description: The internal key of the corresponding table header; and LineNum constitute the primary key of this table row.

Dscription.description: The material or service description saved by document line reflects the historical content of the document and cannot be replaced by the current material master data name; the service line belonging to OINV.DocType=S does not have ItemCode.

FreeTxt.description: document line Free text or remarks.

GrossBuyPr.description: The base price used to calculate this line gross profit can be taken from the price list, latest purchase price, material cost, etc. based on gross profit settings. It is not a fixed actual purchase cost, nor can it be directly regarded as the inventory delivery cost; currency and the pricing unit need to be verified with applicable documents and settings.

GTotal.displayName: Total Line Tax Including Tax (Local Currency)
GTotal.description: document line is the tax-included total after taking line discounts into account, and is used separately from the tax-exclusive LineTotal series; it is not presumed that all header discounts, fees or prepayments have been allocated, nor is it directly equivalent to the total document header total. currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy. Do not press DocCur or line Currency to assign currency to this column. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

GTotalFC.displayName: Total Line Tax Including Tax (Foreign Currency)
GTotalFC.description: document line is the tax-included total after taking line discounts into account, and is used separately from the tax-exclusive LineTotal series; it is not presumed that all header discounts, fees or prepayments have been allocated, nor is it directly equivalent to the total document header total. Normal foreign currency documents interpret currency according to the OINV.DocCur they belong to. This mapping is a combined interpretation of the field family and the document currency rules; the line price Currency cannot be used instead, and cross-documents must be grouped according to currency. The FC column of the local currency document may not be applicable, and the business amount cannot be determined to be zero due to zero or null values. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

GTotalSC.displayName: Total Line Tax Including Tax (System Currency)
GTotalSC.description: document line is the tax-included total after taking line discounts into account, and is used separately from the tax-exclusive LineTotal series; it is not presumed that all header discounts, fees or prepayments have been allocated, nor is it directly equivalent to the total document header total. currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, using the saved amount and not recalculating according to the current exchange rate. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

InvQty.description: The quantity represented by inventory unit of measure; unlike Quantity, whether an inventory movement is formed is still determined by the document and mark.

ItemCode.description: Material identification; identical materials cannot be proven to belong to the same order, work order, or source line.

LineNum.description: Participates in the composite primary key and BaseLine source connection; not the interface sort number VisOrder. Line numbers need not be contiguous and cannot be reconstructed from API collection array indexes.

LineStatus.description: O=Open; C=Close. Closing and canceling have different meanings; they are handled explicitly based on business issues, and valid and canceled documents cannot be mixed.

LineTotal.description: Excluding tax local currency line amount, currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy; does not change the Currency or header DocCur to currency basis. It is not equal to the posted amount of inventory valuation, nor can it be directly equal to the total amount of the document header, ignoring taxes, discounts and rounding differences.

NoInvtryMv.description: There is no inventory quantity change flag, and the presence of the field does not mean that this type of document will necessarily cause inventory movement. Its actual effect must be verified based on the document role, source and applicable settings. Inventory value or accounting impact cannot be inferred based on this field alone.

NumPerMsr.description: The unit of measure conversion value saved in this document line; historical analysis must not be directly overwritten with the current material master data conversion.

ObjType.description: The object type belonging to the current document cannot replace the BaseType explanation source.

OpenInvQty.description: Quantity of open expressed as inventory UoM; used for comparison with basis in stock, still in current status.

OpenQty.description: The current remaining quantity of open; it is not the balance at any historical point in time, nor can it be generally equal to the quantity that has not been shipped or invoiced.

Price.description: document line unit price before tax; the database reference in this table clearly shows the price after line discount. The price currency is taken from this line Currency, and is interpreted according to the this line transaction pricing unit; it is checked with UomEntry/UomCode/unitMsr, UseBaseUn and NumPerMsr, and is not priced according to inventory UoM by default. It is not directly added as the business amount, nor can it be used as the inventory valuation unit price.

PriceAfVAT.displayName: Unit Price Including Tax After Line Discount
PriceAfVAT.description: The tax-included unit price after applying this line discount is not the tax-included price before discount. The price currency is taken from this line Currency, and is interpreted according to the this line transaction pricing unit; it is checked with UomEntry/UomCode/unitMsr, UseBaseUn and NumPerMsr, and is not priced according to inventory UoM by default. It is used separately with the pre-tax price, pre-discount price and line amount, and does not overwrite the historical value with the current tax rate and discount recalculation.

PriceBefDi.displayName: Unit Price Before Discount And Tax
PriceBefDi.description: The pre-tax unit price before this line discount is applied; this table column definition and the SAP unit price rule jointly determine the basis. The price currency is taken from this line Currency, and is interpreted according to the this line transaction pricing unit; it is checked with UomEntry/UomCode/unitMsr, UseBaseUn and NumPerMsr, and is not priced according to inventory UoM by default. Use separately with the discounted price and saved line amount.

Quantity.description: The quantity of sales or purchasing units in a document; the unit must be unified before totaling across documents and materials, and is not directly equivalent to the inventory UoM quantity.

Rate.description: document line currency is converted to exchange rate for company local currency.

ShipDate.description: this line delivery date field; different from the header posting date, whether actual delivery must be combined with the document type.

TargetType.description: The object type of the subsequent target document.

TotalFrgn.description: foreign currency basis of line amount; foreign currency documents are interpreted by belonging to OINV.DocCur, this line DocEntry is associated with OINV.DocEntry, and cross-documents are grouped by DocCur. Row Currency only represents the price currency, and does not assign currency to this column accordingly; LineTotal is used for local currency documents, and the business amount is not judged to be zero based on the zero or empty value of this column.

TotalSumSy.description: system currency basis and currency of line amount take the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy; it is not the unit price, the row Currency or header DocCur is not used as currency, and the saved amount is not recalculated according to the current exchange rate.

unitMsr.description: this line unit of measure display name; used to explain Quantity.

UomCode.description: this line unit of measure code; different unit quantities cannot be added directly before consistency is verified.

UomEntry.description: this line unit of measure mark; should be used together with UomCode and the conversion value saved in the document.

UseBaseUn.description: this line inventory unit of measure mark; combined with Quantity, InvQty and unit code explanation.

VatSum.description: document line total tax, including standard tax and applicable equalization tax, can be manually adjusted; unlike LineVat series net tax, the saved value is not overwritten by the price multiplied by the tax rate. currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy. Do not press DocCur or line Currency to assign currency to this column. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

VatSumFrgn.description: document line total tax, including standard tax and applicable equalization tax, can be manually adjusted; unlike LineVat series net tax, the saved value is not overwritten by the price multiplied by the tax rate. Normal foreign currency documents interpret currency according to the OINV.DocCur they belong to. This mapping is a combined interpretation of the field family and the document currency rules; the line price Currency cannot be used instead, and cross-documents must be grouped according to currency. The FC column of the local currency document may not be applicable, and the business amount cannot be determined to be zero due to zero or null values. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

VatSumSy.description: document line total tax, including standard tax and applicable equalization tax, can be manually adjusted; unlike LineVat series net tax, the saved value is not overwritten by the price multiplied by the tax rate. currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, and uses the saved amount, and does not recalculate according to the current exchange rate. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

VisOrder.description: The display order of document line in the interface.

WhsCode.description: Business lines correspond to warehouses; warehouses, storage locations and materials have different granularities.

Project.description: Project code saved on this line; joins OPRJ.PrjCode. Do not default to the header project or remove historical lines based on current project activity or validity. Distinguish an empty code from an unmatched project master record.

SlpCode.description: Sales employee code saved on this line; joins OSLP.SlpCode. Keep it separate from the header sales employee and the current customer master salesperson; do not force them to agree. Null, unassigned and unmatched values do not identify a default employee.

TreeType.description: Document line BOM role: N=not a BOM, A=assembly, S=sales BOM, I=sales BOM component, P=production BOM, T=template. Distinguishes parent and component roles; it does not define parent/child line keys or justify deleting all components or summing parent and component quantities indiscriminately. Interpret prices and quantities using actual roles and settings; investigate unknown values separately.

OpenSum.description: Only applicable to service document lines with parent OINV.DocType=S. The current open business amount for this line, interpreted separately from LineStatus; OpenQty is not a monetary substitute. It is not a cash receipt, document receivable balance or historical aging value; do not overwrite it with quantity times current price. Currency comes from OADM.MainCurncy in the same company database.

OpenSumFC.description: Only applicable to service document lines with parent OINV.DocType=S. The current open business amount for this line, interpreted separately from LineStatus; OpenQty is not a monetary substitute. It is not a cash receipt, document receivable balance or historical aging value; do not overwrite it with quantity times current price. Verify foreign-currency applicability and currency against the parent document, not the line price Currency; aggregate different currencies separately.

OpenSumSys.description: Only applicable to service document lines with parent OINV.DocType=S. The current open business amount for this line, interpreted separately from LineStatus; OpenQty is not a monetary substitute. It is not a cash receipt, document receivable balance or historical aging value; do not overwrite it with quantity times current price. Currency comes from OADM.SysCurrncy in the same company database.

inv11.displayName: A/R Invoice Down Payment Draw Detail
inv11.description: A/R invoice Prepayment tax deduction/rounding details, primary key (DocEntry, LineNum, LineSeq). It has a different granularity than the material row; it cannot be directly connected to all material rows in the same document and then summed. currency for the local currency amount is the same as company database OADM.MainCurncy, and OADM.SysCurrncy for the system currency amount. The foreign currency deduction amount must be verified by combining the corresponding documents, source prepayment documents and currency; this template has not yet confirmed the currency ownership of all cross-currency deduction situations, and will not automatically infer based on field suffixes or adjacent documents. Deduction is a settlement application and is not added to the invoice amount as additional sales revenue.

ApplGross.description: The tax-included amount has been applied to the deduction details. currency is the same as company database OADM.MainCurncy.

ApplVat.description: The applied tax amount of the deduction details is different from the basic tax amount. currency is the same as company database OADM.MainCurncy.

BaseAbs.description: Points to ODPI.DocEntry; it does not display the order number.

BaseGross.description: The basic tax-inclusive amount of the deduction details. currency is the same as company database OADM.MainCurncy.

BaseType.description: Basic prepayment object type 203; paired with BaseAbs to connect the prepayment header.

BaseVat.description: Basic tax amount for deduction details. currency is the same as company database OADM.MainCurncy.

DocEntry.description: Internal document key belonging to OINV.

Gross.description: The tax-inclusive amount of the current deduction record; original, applied and net amounts must be distinguished. currency is the same as company database OADM.MainCurncy.

GrossFc.description: The tax-included amount of the current deduction record is foreign currency. currency must be verified by combining the corresponding documents and the source prepayment documents; the ownership of currency for cross-currency deductions still needs to be confirmed, and will not be directly aggregated with other currency amounts before confirmation.

GrossSc.description: The tax-included amount of the current deduction record is system currency. currency is the same as company database OADM.SysCurrncy.

IsGross.description: Y = tax-included line, N = net amount line; this basis must be retained during calculation.

LineNum.description: The deduction record is line number; it cannot be regarded as the material detail line number.

LineSeq.description: Together with DocEntry and LineNum, it forms the primary key; it cannot be omitted and directly aggregated or used as a product row.

LineType.description: D=document line, R=currency rounding, H=prepayment document rounding; the rounding type needs to be retained in summary.

ObjType.description: The object type of the current invoice or credit to which this detail belongs.

ApplGrossF.description: Saved applied gross amount of this drawn-payment record. Keep current, applied and base amounts separate, and distinguish net, tax and gross amounts; it is not additional sales revenue. Measure at DocEntry/LineNum/LineSeq grain; do not multiply it by joining every item line of the document. Verify the foreign currency using the parent document, source down payment and cross-currency application. A universal currency source remains unconfirmed; do not infer it from neighboring columns or item line Currency, or aggregate different currencies together.

inv9.description: A/R invoice and prepayment deduction record granularity, primary key (DocEntry, LineNum). Use BaseAbs to associate the prepayment header; originating from the same order cannot replace the actual deduction relationship. currency for the local currency amount is the same as company database OADM.MainCurncy, and OADM.SysCurrncy for the system currency amount. The foreign currency deduction amount must be verified by combining the corresponding documents, source prepayment documents and currency; this template has not yet confirmed the currency ownership of all cross-currency deduction situations, and will not automatically infer based on field suffixes or adjacent documents. Deduction is a settlement application and is not added to the invoice amount as additional sales revenue.

ApplDrawn.description: The net functional currency amount applied; not the full amount of the original advance. currency is the same as company database OADM.MainCurncy.

BaseAbs.description: Points to ODPI.DocEntry; it does not display the order number.

BaseLine.description: Basic record line number; this round has not confirmed that it points to the material details, and automatic connection by DPI1/DPO1.LineNum is prohibited.

DocEntry.description: Internal document key belonging to OINV.

DrawnSum.description: The standard currency does not include the tax deduction amount; DI API AmountToDraw corresponds to this column and cannot exceed the open amount; it is different from the applied net amount. currency is the same as company database OADM.MainCurncy.

DrawnSumFc.description: The net amount of foreign currency saved in the bridge table. currency must be verified by combining the corresponding documents and the source prepayment documents; the ownership of currency for cross-currency deductions still needs to be confirmed, and will not be directly aggregated with other currency amounts before confirmation.

DrawnSumSc.description: The net amount of system currency saved in the bridge table. currency is the same as company database OADM.SysCurrncy.

Gross.description: The tax-inclusive amount of the current deduction record; original, applied and net amounts must be distinguished. currency is the same as company database OADM.MainCurncy.

GrossFc.description: The tax-included amount of the current deduction record is foreign currency. currency must be verified by combining the corresponding documents and the source prepayment documents; the ownership of currency for cross-currency deductions still needs to be confirmed, and will not be directly aggregated with other currency amounts before confirmation.

GrossSc.description: The tax-included amount of the current deduction record is system currency. currency is the same as company database OADM.SysCurrncy.

IsGross.description: Y = tax-included line, N = net amount line; this basis must be retained during calculation.

LineNum.description: The deduction record is line number; it cannot be regarded as the material detail line number.

ObjCode.description: Current invoice or credit object type; used separately from ObjType, which represents the base type of this bridge table.

ObjType.description: This bridge table is a basic object type; it has a different meaning from the ObjType of ordinary marketing rows.

Posted.displayName: Basic Down Payment Has Been Posted
Posted.description: Whether the base document has been posted; not the payment status of the current invoice.

TargetBase.description: B=base, T=target; the default values for invoices and credit tables are not exactly the same and are not uniformly hard-coded.

Vat.description: The tax amount currently deducted from the record. currency is the same as company database OADM.MainCurncy.
