itl1.description: Each LogEntry, ItemCode, SysNumber combination has one row; the batch/sequence master data needs to be distinguished by the superior OITL.ManagedBy and cannot be related solely by SysNumber.

AllocQty.description: The batch sequence allocation amount is not directly equivalent to the actual shipment.

ItemCode.description: It forms the primary key with LogEntry and SysNumber.

MdAbsEntry.description: SDK does not indicate a unique target table in this field; the batch/sequence must be identified and verified, and OBTN or OSRN will not be automatically connected.

PickedQty.description: The picking quantity cannot be regarded as posted out of the warehouse.

Quantity.description: The number of rows assigned to this batch of sequences, and the business direction and impact need to be combined with the log.

ReleaseQty.description: Release the quantity field, which is different from the transaction quantity.

SysNumber.description: It is interpreted within the scope of material and management types and is not globally unique.

itm1.description: There is one row for each material and price list combination; the price list price is the current master data configuration, not the historical inventory valuation or work order issue cost. The price list number is explicitly specified by the business, and a certain number is not selected by default.

ItemCode.description: Associated material master data.

Price.description: Price for this price list row; interpret with Currency, UomEntry and PriceType. It is not historical inventory cost.

PriceList.description: Price list number selected explicitly for the business request; no list number is assumed by default.

Currency.description: Currency of this row Price; do not substitute company or business partner currency or compare amounts across currencies without a defined conversion.

UomEntry.description: Stored unit key for this price, referencing OUOM.UomEntry. Interpret with PriceType; do not substitute the inventory unit. Special values may have no unit master match.

PriceType.description: Database codes: I=inventory UoM price, P=pricing unit price, M=both, O=other UoM price. Interpret Price with UomEntry and Currency; this does not define a complete pricing engine.

itr1.description: each row participates in a reconciliation event, journal entry line, composite keys (ReconNum, LineSeq). The same journal entry line can participate in multiple partial reconciliation s; it cannot be associated only by TransId, otherwise it will be enlarged across rows.

CashDisSum.description: The discount amount involved in reconciliation.

IsCredit.description: C credit, D debit; not equal to income expense classification.

LineSeq.description: It forms the primary key with ReconNum, not the journal entry line number.

netBefDisc.description: The amount before discount cannot be mixed with the reconciliation amount.

ReconSum.description: The amount of reconciliation from the participating banks must be combined with the loan direction, and the payment amount cannot be added to both sides of the loan.

ReconSumFC.description: The amount of foreign currency reconciliation is matched with FrgnCurr.

ShortName.description: Combined with the OITR.IsCard shunt, the full amount cannot be directly connected to OCRD.

SrcObjAbs.description: Diversion must be carried out according to SrcObjTyp, and priority is given to using the entry composite key to trace.

SrcObjTyp.description: String source type; not reconciliation initiated object type.

SumMthCurr.description: According to the explanation of OITR.ReconCurr, it cannot be directly regarded as the amount of local currency.

TransId.description: Co-positioned with TransRowId to participate in journal entry line.

TransRowId.displayName: Participate In Journal Entry Line Number
TransRowId.description: Connecting JDT1.Line_ID must match TransId at the same time.

WTSumFC.description: reconciliation foreign currency withholding tax amount.

WTSumSC.description: reconciliation system currency withholding tax amount.

ExpSumFC.description: Stored reconciliation-row freight amount (FC); FC is labelled by the same row FrgnCurr, not automatically by OITR.ReconCurr. Not an additional cash inflow; do not count both debit and credit sides as receipts.

ExpSumSC.description: Stored reconciliation-row freight amount (SC); Currency is the same company OADM.SysCurrncy. Not an additional cash inflow; do not count both debit and credit sides as receipts.

itt1.description: Each combination of Father and ChildNum forms a row; Code is repeatable and can represent resources, but cannot be used as a unique key for a row or unconditionally associated materials.

ChildNum.description: Combined with Father to form the primary key.

Code.description: Must be combined with Type to identify materials/resources.

Currency.description: BOM price currency.

IssueMthd.description: The delivery method defined by BOM; the order can have its own execution data.

Price.description: BOM price configuration, not historical material delivery cost.

Quantity.description: The usage relative to the base of the parent item BOM is not the delivered material.

Uom.description: The name of component inventory UoM is not the internal identifier of OUOM.

VisOrder.description: Display order; does not replace ChildNum as the component key.

ItemName.description: Component description stored on the BOM; interpret item, resource, and text rows by Type without replacing their description from current master data.

AddQuantit.description: Additional component quantity on the BOM. Preserve the source spelling AddQuantit, distinct from AdditQty on the production-order component.

WipActCode.description: WIP account configuration of the BOM component; not the final account posted by historical transactions.

StageId.description: Stage identifier within the current BOM; not the ORST primary key. Use Father together with this identifier to locate ITT2.

OcrCode.description: Dimension 1 distribution rule saved on this object. Distribution rules are distinct from cost centers; current rule details cannot reconstruct historical actual costs.

OcrCode2.description: Dimension 2 distribution rule saved on this object. Distribution rules are distinct from cost centers; current rule details cannot reconstruct historical actual costs.

OcrCode3.description: Dimension 3 distribution rule saved on this object. Distribution rules are distinct from cost centers; current rule details cannot reconstruct historical actual costs.

OcrCode4.description: Dimension 4 distribution rule saved on this object. Distribution rules are distinct from cost centers; current rule details cannot reconstruct historical actual costs.

OcrCode5.description: Dimension 5 distribution rule saved on this object. Distribution rules are distinct from cost centers; current rule details cannot reconstruct historical actual costs.

ivl1.description: Each TransSeq and LayerID combination is one row; the same inventory transaction can be split into multiple valuation layers. After aggregating the amount at the layer, connect the transactions back to avoid duplicating the transaction quantity.

Balance.description: The layer balance field is not the document line amount.

CalcPrice.displayName: The Valuation Layer Calculates The Unit Price
CalcPrice.description: The calculated price saved at each valuation layer, SDK, does not indicate currency and the denominator unit separately. The component local currency of the normal perpetual inventory material issue is taken as OADM.MainCurncy according to the official rules; when the corresponding historical issue lines UseBaseUn=Y, NumPerMsr=1 and unitMsr are clear, it can be interpreted as local currency/the inventory UoM (the field level is interpreted according to the weaker combination). The relationship between OIVL and actual IGE1 must be verified. OIVL.Currency or OIGE.DocCur cannot be borrowed. When UseBaseUn=N, the price denominator and conversion rules need to be verified; other transactions, especially revaluation, zero quantity, and negative inventory adjustments cannot be applied. Materials can be issued across multiple layers. AVG only represents the arithmetic average of layer prices and cannot be called the comprehensive unit cost. Do not confuse the name with StockPrice, OIVL.Price or amount/quantity conversion price.

LayerID.description: It forms the primary key with TransSeq and is not unique alone.

LayerOutQ.description: Level outbound quantity, the official field is LayerOutQ.

RevalTotal.description: Revaluation value field; zero quantity value adjustment cannot be divided by quantity to calculate unit price.

TransValue.description: The transaction value of the valuation layer retains the positive and negative values ​​​​and NULL. First press TransSeq to aggregate the complete layer, and then connect back to OIVL; the number of OIVL must not be accumulated repeatedly with the number of layers. If the layer is missing or part of the layer amount is NULL, it should be marked as incomplete. SUM cannot be used to skip NULL and then pretend to be the complete amount. currency, zero quantity revaluation and special production processes still require target report verification.

jdt1.description: One posted journal entry line per row, identified by the complete key TransId+Line_ID; line 0 is valid. Account joins OACT for the current account name, while ShortName is a BP or account code. Line and header projects are independent. LC/FC/SC posted movements, current outstanding balances, and date roles are stored separately. Preserve the original signed amounts of reversals.

Account.description: Internal code of the G/L account or BP control account posted to this line. Follow jdt1_oact to OACT.AcctCode for the current account name. This is not FormatCode and must not be replaced with ShortName.

BalDueCred.displayName: Outstanding Credit Balance In Local Currency
BalDueCred.description: Current outstanding credit balance in local currency, identified by OADM.MainCurncy in the same company. This is not a credit posted movement. Historical balances require the postings and reconciliation s/reversal s valid as of the cutoff date.

BalDueDeb.displayName: Outstanding Debit Balance In Local Currency
BalDueDeb.description: Current outstanding debit balance in local currency, identified by OADM.MainCurncy in the same company. This is not a debit posted movement. Filtering this current balance by historical dates does not turn it into a historical cutoff balance.

BalFcCred.displayName: Outstanding Credit Balance In Foreign Currency
BalFcCred.description: The current credit balance of reconciliation foreign currency is matched with FCCurrency in the same line; if the currency tag is missing, local currency cannot be added without authorization, and it does not replace the historical balance.

BalFcDeb.displayName: Outstanding Debit Balance In Foreign Currency
BalFcDeb.description: The current pending debit balance of reconciliation foreign currency matches the same row FCCurrency; it does not accumulate across foreign currency and does not replace the historical balance.

BalScCred.displayName: Outstanding Credit Balance In System Currency
BalScCred.description: The current pending credit balance is reconciliation system currency, currency is from the same company OADM.SysCurrncy; not posted movement or a reconstructed historical balance.

BalScDeb.displayName: Outstanding Debit Balance In System Currency
BalScDeb.description: The current pending debit balance of reconciliation system currency, currency is from the same company OADM.SysCurrncy; not posted movement or the reconstructed historical balance.

BaseRef.description: The business document number from which this entry was generated.

BPLId.description: Accounting branch; does not replace tenant or company database boundaries.

ContraAct.description: The saved counterparty account ID; complete multi-debit and multi-loan matching is not guaranteed, and the default is a pure OACT foreign key. The specific storage and regional differences of business partner codes must be verified. All other journal entry line cannot be expanded and the amount copied.

CreatedBy.description: Interpretation depends on TransType; not automatically equivalent to DocEntry for all tables.

Credit.description: Credit posted movement in local currency, identified by OADM.MainCurncy in the same company. Preserve stored positive and negative signs. Do not apply ABS or flip the sign again based on DebCred or a reversal flag. Debit-positive, credit-negative net movement is Debit-Credit.

DebCred.description: D debit and C credit direction marks; Debit/Credit and other fields have distinguished the debit side and saved the symbols, and will not flip the amount again accordingly.

Debit.description: Debit posted movement in local currency, identified by OADM.MainCurncy in the same company. Preserve stored signs; reversals may be recorded as negative amounts on the original side. Debit-positive, credit-negative net movement is Debit-Credit; it does not automatically represent revenue or profit.

DueDate.description: this line due date; used when selecting the expiration date aging basis. It cannot replace the posting date or document date. Complete time-point evidence is still required for outstanding history.

FCCredit.description: this line foreign currency is credited to posted movement, and currency is explained by the same row FCCurrency; different foreign currency are not directly added, the sign is retained, and the historical currency is not configured from the current account currency.

FCCurrency.description: Foreign currency code for this line, used with FCDebit/FCCredit and BalFc fields. NULL or an empty value does not automatically mean local currency, system currency, or all currencies. Do not substitute the ## configuration value in OACT.ActCurr for an actual currency.

FCDebit.description: this line foreign currency debits posted movement, currency is interpreted by the same line FCCurrency; summarize respectively by foreign currency and retain the sign. Missing currency or zero FC does not equal this line without local currency posted movement.

Line_ID.description: The journal entry line number and 0 number row are valid; they must form a complete row key with TransId. The same line number is not the same row across entries.

OcrCode2.description: The allocation rule code of dimension 2 is used to allocate costs or revenues to one or more profit centers; it is not a single profit center code and is not directly equivalent to OPRC.PrcCode. Complete allocation requires additional review of rule details, weights, dimensions and validity period.

OcrCode3.description: The allocation rule code of dimension 3 is used to allocate costs or revenues to one or more profit centers; it is not a single profit center code and is not directly equivalent to OPRC.PrcCode. Complete allocation requires additional review of rule details, weights, dimensions and validity period.

OcrCode4.description: The allocation rule code of dimension 4 is used to allocate costs or revenues to one or more profit centers; it is not a single profit center code and is not directly equivalent to OPRC.PrcCode. Complete allocation requires additional review of rule details, weights, dimensions and validity period.

OcrCode5.description: The allocation rule code of dimension 5 is used to allocate costs or revenues to one or more profit centers; it is not a single profit center code and is not directly equivalent to OPRC.PrcCode. Complete allocation requires additional review of rule details, weights, dimensions and validity period.

ProfitCode.description: The allocation rule code of dimension 1 is used to allocate costs or revenues to one or more profit centers; it is not a single profit center code and is not directly equivalent to OPRC.PrcCode. Complete allocation requires additional review of rule details, weights, dimensions and validity period.

Project.description: Project code for this journal entry line, joined to OPRJ.PrjCode. It is independent of OJDT.Project: changing the header project does not automatically change the line project. Analysis by line project must not backfill the header project or substitute the current project name for the key.

Ref1.description: journal entry line first reference text; the value is affected by the reference field mapping configuration and is not fixedly interpreted as an invoice number, order number or installment number, and is not a stable associated key. The database defines 200 characters, and the old DI attribute length copy is not used as a truncation rule for this model.

Ref2.description: journal entry line second reference text; the value is affected by the reference field mapping configuration and is not fixedly interpreted as an invoice number, order number or installment number, and is not a stable associated key. The database defines 200 characters, and the old DI attribute length copy is not used as a truncation rule for this model.

Ref3Line.description: journal entry line additional reference text; the value is affected by the reference field mapping configuration and is not fixedly interpreted as an invoice number, order number or installment number, and is not a stable associated key. The database defines 200 characters, and the old DI attribute length copy is not used as a truncation rule for this model.

RefDate.description: this line posting date; is separated from rows TaxDate, DueDate and creation date, and is not automatically overwritten with the first date; the current BalDue balance cannot be used as a historical date balance.

ShortName.description: Business partner or account code, not name; BP line has different meanings from ordinary account lines. It does not unconditionally connect OCRD or OACT, nor does it create a unified discriminator based on whether it is equal to Account.

SourceLine.description: Source row identification; the mapping to product row LineNum under all source types is not uniformly confirmed, and cross-business object row relationships are not automatically established based on this.

SYSCred.description: Credit posted movement in system currency, identified by OADM.SysCurrncy in the same company. Measure it separately from local currency and foreign currency, and preserve the stored sign.

SYSDeb.description: Debit posted movement in system currency, identified by OADM.SysCurrncy in the same company. Measure it separately from local currency and foreign currency, and preserve the stored sign.

TaxDate.description: The this line document date is explained separately with the RefDate posting date and DueDate expiration date.

TransId.description: The internal number of the entry is connected to OJDT.TransId; it co-locates this line with Line_ID and cannot be replaced by the source display number.

TransType.description: this line source object type, interpreted in conjunction with CreatedBy; 30 represents the journal entry category, and manual entry by the interface is not guaranteed.

nnm1.description: SAP Business One document number series; Series is the internal series key, and ObjectCode identifies the applicable document object type. Number series cannot replace document internal keys.

YearTransf.displayName: Whether To Rollover At The End Of The Year

oact.description: each row is a subject and the primary key is AcctCode. It includes postable accounts and title accounts, and names, segment display codes, and internal codes have their own responsibilities; the current name, currency configuration, and balance do not replace historical entry facts, and RealAcct is not used for report account classification.

AcctCode.description: The internal primary key of the account is used to associate JDT1.Account with business documents AcctCode, etc.; it is separated from the segment display code FormatCode, and the name cannot be used to replace the key.

AcctName.description: The current account master data name is used for display after being associated by AcctCode; it is not a connection key and is not guaranteed to be equal to the name at the time of historical posting.

ActCurr.description: Current account currency configuration; ## indicates multiple currency configuration, not a real currency code. It cannot unconditionally overwrite history JDT1.FCCurrency or assign units to row foreign currency posted movement.

ActType.description: I income, E expenses, N other account classifications; they are not a complete balance sheet or profit and loss statement mapping, nor are they replaced by RealAcct.

CreateDate.description: Accounting account creation date.

CurrTotal.description: The current balance snapshot cannot directly give the historical ending balance.

EndTotal.description: Official description Opening Balance; should not be presumed to be the beginning of any selected period.

FatherNum.description: Points to the superior AcctCode; the top level may have no parent node.

FormatCode.description: Format the display code in sections; after querying the display code, you still need to parse AcctCode for association, and do not treat FormatCode as JDT1.Account or an unconfirmed unique key.

Frozen.description: Whether to freeze this accounting account.

FrozenFor.description: Deactivated status and postable attributes are explained separately.

GroupMask.description: Main account group classification; localization and report mapping must be confirmed separately.

LocManTran.description: The Y/N; BP rows must still be identified by business partner semantics.

Postable.description: Y is the postable account, and N is the title account; it is not a replacement for the ValidFor enabled or FrozenFor disabled status. Historical entries are not deleted by default due to the current status of the account.

Project.description: Project configuration in the current account master data. This is not the historical line project in JDT1 and must not backfill or overwrite journal entry line projects.

RealAcct.description: The Y/N index mark of the official Indexed Account; the category of assets, liabilities, equity or profit and loss accounts cannot be determined based on this.

SysTotal.description: Snapshot of current system currency balance.

UpdateDate.description: The date the accounting account was last updated.

ValidFor.description: In the enabled state, configuration such as validity period is still required.

oadm.description: Primary key Code; company database configuration, not transaction fact. Interpret currency, exchange rate directions and cost dimensions through configuration reading, prohibiting unconditional connection with facts. local currency LC in the sales amount is explained by MainCurncy, and system currency SC is explained by SysCurrncy; they may or may not be the same. foreign currency FC and currency must be read according to the specific document field definitions and cannot be replaced by company local currency or system currency. Aggregation across company database must still preserve the company and currency ranges. The local currency and system currency codes are read uniformly in this table and are not deduced from a certain document; this table does not provide the actual foreign currency code of each business document.

Code.description: Official vs. true source primary key; must not be assumed to be globally unique across companies.

ContInvnt.description: Y/N; It cannot be assumed that all company database deposit transactions use the same financial posting mechanism.

Country.description: Company country or region, involving localized semantics.

DirectRate.description: Y is directly exchange rate, N is indirect exchange rate; the conversion must be based on this setting and customer samples, and does not blindly multiply Rate.

InvntSystm.description: A moving average, S standard, F first in, first out; do not cover material-level actual valuation methods and historical settings.

MainCurncy.description: The company's local currency code is the unified currency source that has confirmed the LC amount. This field is read regardless of which source is selected for the document CurSource and whether DocCur is foreign currency. The company's local account book currency code explains the confirmed LC amount. The official perpetual inventory rules use local currency to calculate material costs, which must be used in conjunction with ContInvnt and specific inventory business definitions. All transaction prices are not assigned currency accordingly. local currency cannot be modified after the specified business records are generated in the normal account set; non-standard migration or account set merger requires separate history verification.

RateDec.description: With exchange rate precision configuration, historical posting amounts cannot be recalculated using displayed rounding values.

SumDec.description: The total amount precision configuration cannot replace the actual storage precision and business rounding rules.

SysCurrncy.description: The company's system currency code is the unified currency source of the confirmed SC amount and does not switch with the document CurSource or DocCur. The system currency code for parallel accounting of the same company explains the confirmed SC amount, including JDT1.SYSDeb/SYSCred and BalSc balances, OJDT.SysTotal and sales system currency amounts; it may be the same or different from MainCurncy and does not replace line foreign currency.

UpdateDate.description: The record update date does not represent the complete historical validity period of each setting.

UseMltDims.description: Y/N; affects the interpretation of allocation rule dimensions 1 to 5.

obin.description: The master data of storage locations in the warehouse is associated with the OWHS warehouse; the storage location configuration is not the material inventory quantity or historical inventory.

obtn.description: Each AbsEntry has one piece of master data; ItemCode and SysNumber have unique keys, and the display numbers are not individually unique. No warehouse granularity, not used as warehouse inventory balance or historical inventory.

Balance.description: It cannot be regarded as a historical valuation balance without verification.

CostTotal.description: Affected by the valuation configuration; does not represent the cost of a certain bill of materials.

DistNumber.description: Business display number; the official index is not guaranteed to be unique alone or in combination with materials.

ItemCode.description: Together with SysNumber, it forms the unique key of the system.

MnfDate.description: The manufacturing date of the batch or serial master data is not inventory posting date.

Quantity.description: It does not have warehouse or historical time point granularity and cannot replace warehouse batch serial inventory quantities.

Status.description: Batch status: 0=Released, 1=Not Accessible, 2=Locked. These values differ from serial number statuses and do not replace warehouse on-hand quantities.

SysNumber.description: Must be used in the context of material and management types.

UpdateDate.description: The date the master data was last updated.

obtq.description: The current quantity of the batch in the warehouse; interpreted according to materials, system batch numbers and warehouses, not historical point-in-time inventory or inventory movement flow.

ocr1.description: Cost center and effective date granularity in allocation rules, composite key (OcrCode, PrcCode, ValidFrom). Rules can involve multiple cost centers or valid periods, and source entry amounts cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connection.

ocrd.description: each row is a business partner with a primary key of CardCode. Contains customers, suppliers, and potential customers; current balances and default control accounts cannot replace historical entries.

Balance.description: Snapshot of current business partner balance.

BalanceFC.description: Current business partner foreign currency balance.

BalanceSys.description: Current business partner system currency balance.

CardCode.description: Primary key, customer and supplier share this master data table.

CardName.description: The current name and the historical name are based on the document snapshot.

CardType.description: C customers, S suppliers, L potential customers.

CreateDate.description: Master data creation date.

CreditLine.description: The configured limit cannot be regarded as the uncollected amount.

Currency.description: BP sets currency; multiple currency settings do not mean that all transactions have only one foreign currency.

DebPayAcct.description: Connect OACT; not the actual control account for each historical entry.

GroupNum.description: Default payment terms, specific due date from business documents or entries.

SlpCode.description: Master data assignment personnel.

UpdateDate.description: Master data update date.

validFor.description: Active setting stored as Y/N. Interpret with its period and the other active/inactive settings; this flag alone does not determine availability on a requested date.

validFrom.description: Start date of the active period. Preserve missing dates; do not infer precedence or filter historical transactions by current status.

validTo.description: End date of the active period. Preserve missing dates; do not infer precedence or filter historical transactions by current status.

frozenFor.description: Inactive setting stored as Y/N. Interpret with its period and the other active/inactive settings; this flag alone does not determine availability on a requested date.

frozenFrom.description: Start date of the inactive period. Preserve missing dates; do not infer precedence or filter historical transactions by current status.

frozenTo.description: End date of the inactive period. Preserve missing dates; do not infer precedence or filter historical transactions by current status.

ocrg.description: Business partner grouping master data; used to differentiate between customer groups and supplier groups.

odln.description: Corresponds to the Service Layer sales entity DeliveryNotes (ObjType=15); the physical table is ODLN. Document header granularity, primary key DocEntry. Sales delivery documents; invoicing and returns are subsequent or associated processes, and the delivery amount cannot be directly named as revenue. The amounts are saved as local currency, foreign currency, and system currency basis respectively: currency of DocTotal is the same as company database OADM.MainCurncy, DocTotalSy is OADM.SysCurrncy; foreign currency of the document DocTotalFC is explained according to this table DocCur and summarized according to currency. DocCur can also be equal to local currency, not the unified currency for all amount columns. The total amount of the document, line amount are used separately; the first amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting multiple lines. CurSource represents the source selection of currency. See the field description for the value; the LC/FC/SC definition of each amount column will not be switched accordingly. The local currency and system currency codes MainCurncy/SysCurrncy are always read from the same company database OADM. This object exposes no verified payment or receivable-balance measure. Trace subsequent down payments, receivable documents and actual payments as separate business facts.

Address.description: The customer address on the document.

CANCELED.description: Cancellation role: N=an ordinary document that has not been canceled; Y=the canceled original document; C=a separate cancellation document created by the system to reverse the original document. After cancellation, the original document has Y and the cancellation document has C; both have DocStatus=C (closed). N does not mean open: combine it with DocStatus to distinguish N/O from N/C.

CardCode.description: Customer code, associated with customer master data.

CardName.description: Customer name, used for customer dimension analysis.

Comments.description: Business remark text; cannot replace the structured basic document source relationship.

CreateDate.description: Record creation date; not the actual occurrence of the business or posting date.

DiscPrcnt.description: The discount percentage for the entire document, separate from the detail line discount.

DiscSum.description: The discount amount of the document header is used separately with the discount percentage and line discount price of line DiscPrcnt, and the line discount is not deducted repeatedly. currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy, and does not press DocCur or line Currency to assign currency to this column. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

DiscSumFC.description: The discount amount of the document header is used separately with the discount percentage and line discount price of line DiscPrcnt, and the line discount is not deducted repeatedly. Normal foreign currency documents interpret currency according to this table DocCur. This mapping is a combined interpretation of field family and document currency rules; the line price Currency cannot be used instead, and cross-documents must be grouped according to currency. The FC column of the local currency document may not be applicable, and the business amount cannot be determined to be zero due to zero or null values. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

DiscSumSy.description: The discount amount of the document header is used separately with the discount percentage and line discount price of line DiscPrcnt, and the line discount is not deducted repeatedly. currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, using the saved amount and not recalculating according to the current exchange rate. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

CurSource.description: Source of document currency: L=local currency, S=system currency, C=business partner currency. C is not equal to foreign currency identification, the actual document currency reads DocCur and is compared with company local currency. The local currency and system currency codes read the same company database OADM.MainCurncy and OADM.SysCurrncy respectively. This field does not change the LC/FC/SC basis defined in each amount column, nor does it replace the line price Currency.

DocCur.description: Actual document currency code, which may equal company local currency. CurSource selects its source; C=business partner currency does not itself mean foreign currency. For applicable foreign-currency documents, DocTotalFC uses this currency. DocTotal uses OADM.MainCurncy from the same company database, and DocTotalSy uses OADM.SysCurrncy. Line Currency describes prices and does not assign a common currency to every amount column.

DocDate.description: posting date of the document; used separately with TaxDate document date, CreateDate creation date.

DocDueDate.description: The database reference is defined as due date; the specific interface and regionalized use of this document still need to be verified and will not be interpreted as the payment due date, actual delivery date or payment receipt date by default.

DocEntry.description: The internal primary key of this table; this key is used for association and cannot be replaced by the displayed order number DocNum.

DocNum.description: The business displays the order number; the number series and document type affect uniqueness and are not used as cross-table unique keys.

DocRate.description: The exchange rate recorded in the document; the conversion direction and local currency/foreign currency basis should be consistent with the company configuration.

DocStatus.description: Document open and closed status, only O=open, C=closed. Judgment based on CANCELED: N/O=not canceled but open, N/C=not canceled but closed; after completing the reverse cancellation, original document is Y/C, and the new cancellation order is C/C. C in DocStatus means closure, which is different from C in CANCELED, which means cancellation document; closed itself cannot prove that everything has been handed in or collected. API property DocumentStatus uses bost_Open/bost_Close (ordinals 0/1) for open/closed status. SQL filters on this column still use O/C, never API names or ordinals; other shared enum members are not added as valid column values. Undefined values remain unverified.

DocTotal.description: The total amount of document header local currency and currency are the same as company database OADM.MainCurncy; even if DocCur is foreign currency, this column basis will not be changed. The total document amount must be combined with applicable taxes, whole order discounts, fees and rounding explanations, and does not equal tax-exclusive revenue, inventory costs or a simple total of line amount. The details cannot be accumulated repeatedly after being connected.

DocTotalFC.description: The total amount of the document header is foreign currency. For normal foreign currency documents, use this table DocCur to interpret currency and group them; local currency documents use DocTotal. It cannot be assumed that there is no business amount just because this column is zero or empty. The total amount of the document must be combined with applicable taxes, whole order discounts, fees and rounding explanations, and does not equal tax-exclusive revenue, inventory costs or a simple total of line amount. The details cannot be accumulated repeatedly after being connected.

DocTotalSy.description: The total amount of document header system currency, currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, not DocCur or line Currency; use the saved amount and do not recalculate according to the current exchange rate. The total document amount must be combined with applicable taxes, whole order discounts, fees and rounding explanations, and does not equal tax-exclusive revenue, inventory costs or a simple total of line amount. The details cannot be accumulated repeatedly after being connected.

DocType.description: I=material document, S=service document; the document object type code is different from ObjType. The service line does not need ItemCode and should be interpreted in conjunction with the lines Dscription and AcctCode. The service amount cannot be excluded due to lack of material coding. API enum members dDocument_Items/dDocument_Service (ordinals 0/1) are reference mappings only. SQL filters use I/S, never enum names or ordinals. Undefined values remain unverified.

GrosProfit.description: The gross profit amount of the document.

JrnlMemo.description: Summary of accounting documents generated by document posting.

NumAtCard.description: Customer order number or external reference number.

ObjType.description: This document object type code is distinguished from the source line BaseType. The actual database type must be verified. This table represents DeliveryNotes, with object type code 15; it is distinct from DocType I/S and does not identify the source object.

ReqDate.description: Date on which the customer expects to receive the goods; not a cancellation date, posting date or actual receipt event. Interpret separately from DocDueDate and the line ShipDate planning values.

RoundDif.description: The difference between the original amount of the document and the amount after rounding; the recorded positive and negative values are retained and are not recalculated according to the currently displayed decimal places. currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy. Do not press DocCur or line Currency to assign currency to this column. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

RoundDifFC.description: The difference between the original amount of the document and the amount after rounding; the recorded positive and negative values are retained and are not recalculated according to the currently displayed decimal places. Normal foreign currency documents interpret currency according to this table DocCur. This mapping is a combined interpretation of the field family and the document currency rules; the line price Currency cannot be used instead, and cross-documents must be grouped according to currency. The FC column of the local currency document may not be applicable, and the business amount cannot be determined to be zero due to zero or null values. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

RoundDifSy.description: The difference between the original amount of the document and the amount after rounding; the recorded positive and negative values are retained and are not recalculated according to the currently displayed decimal places. currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, using the saved amount and not recalculating according to the current exchange rate. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

Series.description: Document number series, associated with NNM1.Series; interpreted with DocNum to display the number, and cannot replace DocEntry as the internal key of the document.

SlpCode.description: Internal coding of salesperson, associated with salesperson master data.

TaxDate.description: The database reference is marked as the document date, FP2508 DI API is explained as the tax calculation or payment date; it is interpreted according to localization and actual business use, and is different from posting date DocDate.

TotalExpFC.description: Document surcharges or total freight charges are included in this document expense and do not represent all operating expenses of the enterprise; they are used separately with taxes, discounts and product line amount. Normal foreign currency documents interpret currency according to this table DocCur. This mapping is a combined interpretation of field family and document currency rules; the line price Currency cannot be used instead, and cross-documents must be grouped according to currency. The FC column of the local currency document may not be applicable, and the business amount cannot be determined to be zero due to zero or null values. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

TotalExpns.description: Document surcharges or total freight charges are included in this document expense and do not represent all operating expenses of the enterprise; they are used separately with taxes, discounts and product line amount. currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy, and does not press DocCur or line Currency to assign currency to this column. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

TotalExpSC.description: Document surcharges or total freight charges are included in this document expense and do not represent all operating expenses of the enterprise; they are used separately with taxes, discounts and product line amount. currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, using the saved amount and not recalculating according to the current exchange rate. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

TransId.description: Association OJDT.TransId; document internal key DocEntry is not equivalent to entry key.

UpdateDate.description: Record update date; not business posting date.

VatSum.description: The header tax amount of the document is recorded according to the applicable tax system; the header tax amount may include expense tax and is not preset to be equal to the sum of ordinary sales tax amounts. currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy. Do not press DocCur or line Currency to assign currency to this column. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

VatSumFC.description: The header tax amount of the document is recorded according to the applicable tax system; the header tax amount may include expense tax and is not preset to be equal to the sum of ordinary sales tax amounts. Normal foreign currency documents interpret currency according to this table DocCur. This mapping is a combined interpretation of the field family and the document currency rules; the line price Currency cannot be used instead, and cross-documents must be grouped according to currency. The FC column of the local currency document may not be applicable, and the business amount cannot be determined to be zero due to zero or null values. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

VatSumSy.description: The header tax amount of the document is recorded according to the applicable tax system; the header tax amount may include expense tax and is not preset to be equal to the sum of ordinary sales tax amounts. currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, using the saved amount and not recalculating according to the current exchange rate. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

Project.description: Project code saved on this document header; joins OPRJ.PrjCode. Interpret header Project separately from line Project; never overwrite all line projects with the header value or filter historical documents by current project activity.

odpi.description: Corresponds to the Service Layer sales entity DownPayments (ObjType=203); the physical table is ODPI. Document header granularity, primary key DocEntry. Prepayment business documents; source documents and final invoice deductions are two types of relationships. Received, deducted and posted are judged separately. The amounts are saved as local currency, foreign currency, and system currency basis respectively: currency of DocTotal/PaidToDate is the same as company database OADM.MainCurncy, DocTotalSy/PaidSys is OADM.SysCurrncy; foreign currency of the document DocTotalFC/PaidFC is explained according to this table DocCur and summarized according to currency. DocCur can also be equal to local currency, not the unified currency for all amount columns. The total amount of the document, the current accumulated payment amount and line amount are used separately; the first amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting multiple lines. CurSource represents the source selection of currency. See the field description for the value; the LC/FC/SC definition of each amount column will not be switched accordingly. The local currency and system currency codes MainCurncy/SysCurrncy are always read from the same company database OADM.

CANCELED.description: Cancellation identification, only N=uncancelled, Y=cancelled prepayment documents. The advance payment request can be canceled, and no reverse cancellation document will be created when canceling; this cancellation operation is not applicable to A/P down payment invoice. Combined with DocStatus: N/O=not canceled but open, N/C=not canceled but closed; Y means canceled. Closing, payment or credit cannot be treated as cancellation.

CardCode.description: Customer code, associated with customer master data.

CardName.description: Customer name, used for customer dimension analysis.

The local currency and system currency codes read the same company database OADM.MainCurncy and OADM.SysCurrncy respectively. This field does not change the LC/FC/SC basis defined in each amount column, nor does it replace the line price Currency.

DocCur.description: The actual currency code of the document can be equal to the company local currency. CurSource records the source selection of currency, where C=business partner currency, which does not directly represent foreign currency; the applicability of foreign currency is determined based on this field and the company local currency. The DocTotalFC/PaidFC of normal foreign currency documents are explained as currency; the local currency codes of DocTotal/PaidToDate are uniformly the same company database OADM.MainCurncy, DocTotalSy/PaidSys The system currency code is uniformly OADM.SysCurrncy. Row Currency only interprets the row price currency, and does not assign currency to all amount columns.

DocDate.description: posting date of the document; used separately with TaxDate document date, CreateDate creation date.

DocDueDate.description: The database reference is defined as due date; the specific interface and regionalized use of this document still need to be verified and will not be interpreted as the payment due date, actual delivery date or payment receipt date by default.

DocEntry.description: The internal primary key of this table; this key is used for association and cannot be replaced by the displayed order number DocNum.

DocNum.description: The business displays the order number; the number series and document type affect uniqueness and are not used as cross-table unique keys.

DocRate.description: The exchange rate recorded in the document; the conversion direction and local currency/foreign currency basis should be consistent with the company configuration.

DocStatus.description: The open and closed status of the prepayment document is only O=open and C=closed. Combined with CANCELED: N/O=open is not canceled, N/C=closed is not canceled; CANCELED=Y means cancellation, and cancellation cannot be determined by DocStatus alone. Requests, invoices, collections and deductions need to be judged separately. closed itself does not prove that full payment or full deduction has been made. API property DocumentStatus uses bost_Open/bost_Close (ordinals 0/1) for open/closed status. SQL filters on this column still use O/C, never API names or ordinals; other shared enum members are not added as valid column values. Undefined values remain unverified.

DocTotal.description: The total amount of document header local currency and currency are the same as company database OADM.MainCurncy; even if DocCur is foreign currency, this column basis will not be changed. The total document amount must be combined with applicable taxes, whole order discounts, fees and rounding explanations, and does not equal tax-exclusive revenue, inventory costs or a simple total of line amount. The details cannot be accumulated repeatedly after being connected.

The details cannot be accumulated repeatedly after being connected.

DocTotalSy.description: The total amount of document header system currency, currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, not DocCur or line Currency; use the saved amount and do not recalculate according to the current exchange rate. The total document amount must be combined with applicable taxes, whole order discounts, fees and rounding explanations, and does not equal tax-exclusive revenue, inventory costs or a simple total of line amount. The details cannot be accumulated repeatedly after being connected.

DocType.description: I=material document, S=service document; the document object type code is different from ObjType. The service line does not need ItemCode and should be interpreted in conjunction with the lines Dscription and AcctCode. The service amount cannot be excluded due to lack of material coding. API enum members dDocument_Items/dDocument_Service (ordinals 0/1) are reference mappings only. SQL filters use I/S, never enum names or ordinals. Undefined values remain unverified.

DpmAmnt.description: The functional currency of the advance payment amount is basis. currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy, and currency is not assigned the amount of local currency as DocCur.

DpmAmntFC.description: The prepayment amount is foreign currency basis; clarify the foreign currency code before use. The specific source of currency must be verified based on the advance payment and its application scenarios. This template has not yet been confirmed; it cannot be directly promoted from the currency mapping of DocTotalFC, and it will not be aggregated across currency until it is confirmed.

DpmAmntSC.description: The prepayment amount is system currency basis. currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, and the saved amount is not recalculated according to the current exchange rate.

DpmAppl.description: Applied prepayment amount; differs from payment amount and original prepayment amount. currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy, and does not assign currency to the amount of local currency as DocCur.

DpmApplFc.description: foreign currency basis of the applied amount. The specific source of currency must be verified based on the advance payment and its application scenarios. This template has not yet been confirmed; it cannot be directly promoted from the currency mapping of DocTotalFC, and it will not be aggregated across currency until it is confirmed.

DpmApplSc.description: system currency basis of the applied amount. currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, and the saved amount is not recalculated according to the current exchange rate.

DpmPrcnt.description: The prepayment percentage of the document; not directly used as the current unpaid balance ratio.

ObjType.description: This document object type code is distinguished from the source line BaseType. The actual database type must be verified. This table represents DownPayments, with object type code 203; it is distinct from DocType I/S and does not identify the source object.

PaidFC.displayName: Cumulative Amount Received And Paid (Foreign Currency)
PaidFC.description: Current cumulative amount paid or received in foreign currency. For foreign currency documents, the currency is this table's DocCur; group by DocCur across documents. This is not the foreign currency unpaid balance or the payment movement for a specified historical period. For local currency documents, use PaidToDate.

PaidSys.displayName: Cumulative Amount Received And Paid (System Currency)
PaidSys.description: The current cumulative amount of receipts and payments in the document is system currency, currency is taken as OADM.SysCurrncy; it is not the unpaid amount or the receipts and payments in the specified historical period posted movement. The same currency basis must be used when comparing with the total amount of the document.

PaidToDate.displayName: Cumulative Amount Received And Paid (Local Currency)
PaidToDate.description: The current cumulative amount of receipts and payments in the document is local currency, and currency is equal to OADM.MainCurncy; it cannot be regarded as posted movement as the receipts and payments in the specified historical period, nor is it the unpaid amount. The same currency basis must be used when comparing with the total amount of the document.

Posted.displayName: The Advance Payment Has Been Posted

When querying inventory flow or net offset, the original transaction and reversal records should be retained and processed according to the actual date, quantity, direction and amount respectively. Cancel filtering of sales cannot be simply applied.

oinv.description: Corresponds to the Service Layer sales entity Invoices (ObjType=13); the physical table is OINV. Document header granularity, primary key DocEntry. The total amount of the document, the current accumulated payment amount and line amount are used separately; the first amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting multiple lines. CurSource represents the source selection of currency. See the field description for the value; the LC/FC/SC definition of each amount column will not be switched accordingly. The local currency and system currency codes MainCurncy/SysCurrncy are always read from the same company database OADM.

Address.description: The customer address on the document.

CANCELED.description: Cancellation role: N=an ordinary document that has not been canceled; Y=the canceled original document; C=a separate cancellation document created by the system to reverse the original document. After cancellation, the original document has Y and the cancellation document has C; both have DocStatus=C (closed). N does not mean open: combine it with DocStatus to distinguish N/O from N/C.

The local currency and system currency codes read the same company database OADM.MainCurncy and OADM.SysCurrncy respectively. This field does not change the LC/FC/SC basis defined in each amount column, nor does it replace the line price Currency.

DocCur.description: The actual currency code of the document can be equal to the company local currency. CurSource records the source selection of currency, where C=business partner currency, which does not directly represent foreign currency; the applicability of foreign currency is determined based on this field and the company local currency. The DocTotalFC/PaidFC of normal foreign currency documents are explained as currency; the local currency codes of DocTotal/PaidToDate are uniformly the same company database OADM.MainCurncy, DocTotalSy/PaidSys The system currency code is uniformly OADM.SysCurrncy. Row Currency only interprets the row price currency, and does not assign currency to all amount columns.

DocDate.description: posting date of the document; used separately with TaxDate document date, CreateDate creation date.

DocDueDate.description: The payment due/value date of A/R invoice is not the actual receipt date or delivery date.

DocEntry.description: The internal primary key of this table; this key is used for association and cannot be replaced by the displayed order number DocNum.

DocNum.description: The business displays the order number; the number series and document type affect uniqueness and are not used as cross-table unique keys.

DocRate.description: The exchange rate recorded in the document; the conversion direction and local currency/foreign currency basis should be consistent with the company configuration.

DocStatus.description: Document open and closed status, only O=open, C=closed. Judgment based on CANCELED: N/O=not canceled but open, N/C=not canceled but closed; after completing the reverse cancellation, original document is Y/C, and the new cancellation order is C/C. C in DocStatus means closure, which is different from C in CANCELED, which means cancellation document; closed itself cannot prove that everything has been handed in or collected. API property DocumentStatus uses bost_Open/bost_Close (ordinals 0/1) for open/closed status. SQL filters on this column still use O/C, never API names or ordinals; other shared enum members are not added as valid column values. Undefined values remain unverified.

DocTotal.description: The total amount of document header local currency and currency are the same as company database OADM.MainCurncy; even if DocCur is foreign currency, this column basis will not be changed. The total document amount must be combined with applicable taxes, whole order discounts, fees and rounding explanations, and does not equal tax-exclusive revenue, inventory costs or a simple total of line amount. When there is a prepayment deduction, the impact of the deduction on the total amount should also be checked, and this column should not be defaulted to the value before deduction. The details cannot be accumulated repeatedly after being connected.

DocTotalFC.description: The total amount of the document header is foreign currency. For normal foreign currency documents, use this table DocCur to interpret currency and group them; local currency documents use DocTotal. It cannot be assumed that there is no business amount just because this column is zero or empty. The total amount of the document must be combined with applicable taxes, whole order discounts, fees and rounding explanations, and does not equal tax-exclusive revenue, inventory costs or a simple total of line amount. When there is a prepayment deduction, the impact of the deduction on the total amount should also be checked, and this column should not be defaulted to the value before deduction. The details cannot be accumulated repeatedly after being connected.

DocTotalSy.description: The total amount of document header system currency, currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, not DocCur or line Currency; use the saved amount and do not recalculate according to the current exchange rate. The total document amount must be combined with applicable taxes, whole order discounts, fees and rounding explanations, and does not equal tax-exclusive revenue, inventory costs or a simple total of line amount. When there is a prepayment deduction, the impact of the deduction on the total amount should also be checked, and this column should not be defaulted to the value before deduction. The details cannot be accumulated repeatedly after being connected.

API enum members dDocument_Items/dDocument_Service (ordinals 0/1) are reference mappings only. SQL filters use I/S, never enum names or ordinals. Undefined values remain unverified.

GrosProfit.description: The gross profit amount of the document.

isIns.description: Y=receivable reserved invoice, N=non-reserved invoice. PaidSys.displayName: Cumulative Amount Received And Paid (System Currency)
