oitl.displayName: Item Batch And Serial Transaction Log
oitl.description: Each LogEntry is a transaction log; it includes different impacts such as actual inventory, commitments, and orders. All logs cannot be regarded as physical goods entering and exiting the warehouse.

ApplyType.description: Matched with ApplyEntry/ApplyLine, it cannot be the same as the document to which the log belongs by default.

BaseEntry.description: Source document internal key.

BaseLine.description: Source line number.

BaseType.description: Matched with BaseEntry/BaseLine, indicating the source chain.

DocDate.description: Trade posting date.

DocEntry.description: Matched with DocType and DocLine to identify document line to which the log belongs.

DocLine.description: The field in this table is called DocLine, not DocLineNum.

DocQty.description: The document quantity field is processed separately from the inventory impact quantity.

DocType.description: This log document type cannot be mixed with BaseType or ApplyType.

ItemCode.description: Associated OITM.

LocCode.description: Use LocType to explain the position range.

ManagedBy.description: 10000044 batch, 10000045 sequence, 4 common material; this judgment is required for downstream master data connection.

StockEff.description: 0 has no accumulation, 1 is on hand, 2 is committed, and 3 is ordered; commitments and on hand cannot be mixed together.

StockQty.description: Inventory affects quantity and must be combined with StockEff.

SubLineNum.description: Sub-row information does not replace DocLine.

LocType.description: Interpret the location together with LocCode. Do not treat every location as a warehouse before verifying the location type values.

CreateDate.description: System creation date; use it separately from the transaction posting date DocDate.

oitm.description: One line for each material code; provides current classification, inventory management and unit attributes. The current quantity and price cannot be used as historical work order issues or historical costs.

AvgPrice.description: Existing material cost field; the moving average price is updated with the sending and receiving transactions. The current price cannot be used to replace the historical picking unit price. Other valuation methods will be explained according to the configuration.

BuyUnitMsr.description: Procurement business unit does not default to inventory UoM.

DfltWH.description: The default configuration does not represent all actual trading warehouses.

EvalSystem.description: A moving average, S standard, F first in first out, B batch/serial number valuation; batch management switch and batch valuation method are different attributes.

InvntItem.description: Distinguish between inventory materials and materials that do not affect inventory quantities.

InvntryUom.description: The current inventory UoM name of the material; the inventory quantity cannot be added directly to the purchase or sales quantity. When interpreting historical transactions, this line is used first to clarify the inventory UoM mark and the saved unit name; the current name cannot unconditionally replace historical manual labels or conversion relationships.

IsCommited.description: The currently committed quantity is not equivalent to the actual shipment or material quantity.

ItemCode.description: Material master data business key; not document line unique key.

ItemName.description: Current master data name; historical document description may be different.

ItmsGrpCod.description: Associated with OITB, use business-confirmed groups to define categories such as steel, without relying on a small number of material coding guesses.

IUoMEntry.description: Association OUOM, without unit name as key.

LastPurPrc.description: Last purchase price interpreted with LastPurCur and LastPurDat; it is not an inventory valuation transaction amount or historical production issue cost.

LeadTime.description: Material procurement or replenishment lead time, in days.

ManBtchNum.description: Lot management switch; this alone cannot be used to assert per-lot valuation.

MinLevel.description: Minimum inventory level maintained in material master data.

OnHand.description: Current balance; this field does not have a historical cutoff date dimension.

OnOrder.description: The current order quantity is not the same as the received quantity.

SalUnitMsr.description: Sales business unit, does not default to inventory UoM.

UgpEntry.displayName: Unit Of Measure Group Internal Identifier
UgpEntry.description: To associate OUGP, special values such as manual units must be checked.

validFor.description: Active setting stored as Y/N. Interpret with its period and the other active/inactive settings; this flag alone does not determine availability on a requested date.

validFrom.description: Start date of the active period. Preserve missing dates; do not infer precedence or filter historical transactions by current status.

validTo.description: End date of the active period. Preserve missing dates; do not infer precedence or filter historical transactions by current status.

VatGroupPu.description: Material purchase tax group code, associated tax group master data.

LastPurCur.description: Currency paired with LastPurPrc and LastPurDat; do not substitute company currency or infer historical purchasing sources from current values.

frozenFor.description: Inactive setting stored as Y/N. Interpret with its period and the other active/inactive settings; this flag alone does not determine availability on a requested date.

frozenFrom.description: Start date of the inactive period. Preserve missing dates; do not infer precedence or filter historical transactions by current status.

frozenTo.description: End date of the inactive period. Preserve missing dates; do not infer precedence or filter historical transactions by current status.

oitr.description: One internal reconciliation per row, identified by ReconNum. It can reconcile BP or G/L accounts and may involve multiple BP. Canceling a reconciliation and reversing a financial journal entry are distinct events.

BPLId.description: The branch to which reconciliation belongs.

CancelAbs.description: The association is canceled or reconciliation cancellation; the direction and cancellation time must be confirmed with samples.

Canceled.description: Y/N; the cancellation event must be restored at the historical time point at the same time, and the current N cannot be filtered only.

CreateDate.description: The technology was created on the day it was created and cannot replace ReconDate.

InitObjAbs.description: Must be combined with InitObjTyp diversion; should not be directly used as payment DocEntry.

InitObjTyp.description: The string type has a different meaning from the participating row SrcObjTyp.

IsMultiBP.description: When Y, it cannot be assumed that the entire reconciliation belongs to only one CardCode.

IsSystem.description: Distinguish between system and manual sources; keep them separately from ReconType.

OldMatNum.description: Historical related information, not the current unique key.

ReconCurr.description: currency used by reconciliation is not equal to foreign currency for all rows.

ReconDate.description: The business date is reconciliation; it is processed separately from the creation date and document posting date.

ReconJEId.description: The entry generated by reconciliation; not the summary code of all participating entries.

ReconType.description: String 0 manual, 1 automatic, 2 semi-automatic, 3 payment, 4 credit, 5 reverse, 7 cancellation, etc.

Total.description: The total amount at the head level cannot be repeated after connecting the details on both sides of the loan and debit.

oitt.description: A current bill of materials for each parent item Code; it is not a production order execution snapshot, and historical work order analysis should be based on OWOR/WOR1.

Code.description: BOM primary key, associated with OITM.ItemCode.

CreateDate.description: Currently BOM creation date.

PriceList.description: BOM price configuration, not inventory historical cost.

Project.description: BOM project configuration.

Qauntity.description: The official field is spelled Qauntity, do not change it to Quantity; component usage must be interpreted based on this base number.

ToWH.description: BOM default warehouse for finished products.

TreeType.description: A assembly, S sales, P production, T template.

UpdateDate.description: BOM update date, not a complete historical version.

Name.description: Product description stored on the BOM; current BOM configuration does not replace the historical production-order product description.

OcrCode.description: Dimension 1 distribution rule saved on this object. Distribution rules are distinct from cost centers; current rule details cannot reconstruct historical actual costs.

OcrCode2.description: Dimension 2 distribution rule saved on this object. Distribution rules are distinct from cost centers; current rule details cannot reconstruct historical actual costs.

OcrCode3.description: Dimension 3 distribution rule saved on this object. Distribution rules are distinct from cost centers; current rule details cannot reconstruct historical actual costs.

OcrCode4.description: Dimension 4 distribution rule saved on this object. Distribution rules are distinct from cost centers; current rule details cannot reconstruct historical actual costs.

OcrCode5.description: Dimension 5 distribution rule saved on this object. Distribution rules are distinct from cost centers; current rule details cannot reconstruct historical actual costs.

oitw.description: One row per material and warehouse combination; current inventory snapshot cannot be used to answer balances or period issues for a past date.

AvgPrice.description: It must be explained in conjunction with whether the company is based on warehouse management costs and valuation methods.

IsCommited.description: The current committed quantity is not the shipped quantity.

ItemCode.description: Confirm the record jointly with WhsCode.

Locked.description: The locked configuration of the material in this warehouse.

MinStock.description: Inventory threshold configuration, not actual inventory.

OnHand.description: Current warehouse inventory balance; not cumulative incoming quantity.

OnOrder.description: The current order quantity, not the stocked quantity.

StockValue.description: Current inventory value; it cannot be directly used as a historical point in time or historical outbound cost.

WhsCode.description: Confirm the record jointly with ItemCode.

oivl.description: Each TransSeq is a valuation transaction; when TransType=60, use CreatedBy and DocLineNum to trace IGE1.DocEntry and LineNum. There can be multiple transactions from the same source line. First aggregate the IVL1 layer by TransSeq, and then aggregate it by source row to avoid copying the transaction quantity and amount. No valuation, NULL valuation amount and confirmed zero value are retained respectively; the value reduction of production issuing inventory is usually negative, and the forward issuing cost clearly takes a negative value, and ABS does not need to swallow up the reverse direction.

BASE_REF.description: Reference number, not declared to be globally unique.

CostMethod.description: A moving average, S standard, F first in first out, B batch sequence, N none; historical transaction methods may be different from the current material configuration.

CreateDate.description: System creation date; it needs to be explained separately with posting date during retrospective valuation.

CreatedBy.description: It is not a user creation; it co-locates the source document line with TransType and DocLineNum.

Currency.description: The official definition is Price Currency, which only explains the original price; not the currency tag for the SumStock inventory posting amount. The amount of inventory local currency is explained by company OADM.MainCurncy. system currency and foreign currency are checked separately. The inventory amount is not divided into currency or exchanged according to this field.

DocDate.description: Inventory transaction posting date.

DocLineNum.description: Associate the source document LineNum; do not use SubLineNum or BaseLine of the source document instead.

InQty.description: The quantity of the warehousing direction of this transaction; the transaction granularity should be fixed before associating IVL1.

InvntAct.description: The inventory account of the inventory valuation transaction is officially associated with OACT. When reconciling, first aggregate the valuation amount based on the complete source document and this inventory account, and then compare it with the net debit and credit amount of JDT1.Account corresponding to the document TransId; you cannot compare a single work order subset to the entire multiple work order voucher.

ItemCode.description: Used for the material dimension and is not sufficient to prove that the transaction belongs to a specific work order.

LocCode.description: The valuation exchange is in the warehouse code; the allocation is in the warehouse direction.

MessageID.description: Associated with OILM.MessageID, it cannot be used as OITL.LogEntry.

OpenQty.description: The current open quantity field is not equal to the transaction quantity or any historical balance.

OutQty.description: The quantity in the outbound direction of this transaction; the net change candidate is incoming minus outgoing, which needs to be verified according to the transaction range.

Price.description: Official Price, currency context is Currency. Separate from document line StockPrice, layer CalcPrice and the posting price converted according to the inventory quantity; multiplying the quantity in this field does not guarantee that the entire deposited accounting amount will be restored.

Rate.description: Matched with the price currency, do not guess the conversion direction based on the name.

SubLineNum.description: The running water sub-line information is not the source number document line.

SumStock.description: Official Sum Stock Value. Preserve the sign of inventory movements: increases are positive and decreases are negative. For regular production issues, an explicitly defined positive-cost measure may take the negative of this signed value; do not use ABS to erase reversals. Interpret it in local currency OADM.MainCurncy and reconcile it with the target database valuation layers and inventory account postings. It is distinct from IGE1.StockValue (Total COGS Value). Keep NULL as unknown; missing valuation rows must not automatically become zero or fall back to document amounts.

TransSeq.description: The unique identifier of the inventory valuation transaction, which only identifies the transaction and does not identify the valuation layer. COUNT(TransSeq) gets the number of transactions; one transaction can still correspond to multiple IVL1 valuation layer records, and it cannot be judged based on this that there is only one layer or no stratification has occurred. Layer records are distinguished by IVL1.TransSeq+LayerID; only when it is necessary to determine the number of layers or layer costs, press the complete key to read, and the number of transactions is not called the number of layers. The document number, material or document line combination cannot be used to replace the primary key of this transaction.

TransType.description: 59 receipt, 60 shipment, 67 transfer, 162 revaluation, etc.; cross-source association must limit the type.

WipAct.description: Official WIP Inventory Account; it is distinguished from the inventory account InvntAct and the work-in-progress difference account. All entries are regarded as the material issue amount regardless of the name.

WipVal.description: Official WIP Inventory Value; and SumStock inventory value changes are reserved separately and used for work-in-progress posting verification of the target production business. They are not automatically defined as the current issue material cost or the final work order cost.

PostStatus.description: N=None, P=Partial, C=Complete. Preserve the status; do not default to C without confirming the applicable reporting rules.

ojdt.description: each row is a posted journal entry, the primary key is TransId, and Series+Number is the other unique key. The head amount and items are saved separately with the JDT1 row granularity; the head amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting multiple rows. Inverting settings does not prove execution, does not guess cancellation status by summary or source type.

AdjTran.description: Y/N; retain the end-of-period adjustment analysis boundary.

AutoStorno.description: Y/N automatic reversal setting; DI means that the reverse transaction is created in StornoDate, which does not mean that reversal has been completed.

BaseRef.description: Used for display traceability; cannot replace the source internal key.

CreateDate.description: The system records the creation date, not the business posting date.

CreatedBy.description: Must be interpreted in conjunction with TransType; DocEntry must not be directly associated across object types.

DueDate.description: Header due date; when analyzing journal entry line or installment by maturity date, the corresponding row date must be read, and it should not be used to replace the posting date.

FcTotal.description: The total amount of the entry header foreign currency; the specific currency and the applicability of multi-currency entries must be verified in conjunction with the entry. Each JDT1 line is not unconditionally assigned the same foreign currency; the header granularity is maintained.

Indicator.description: A reference designator or indicator for an accounting document.

LocTotal.description: Journal entry header total in local currency, identified by OADM.MainCurncy in the same company. Preserve header granularity: do not sum duplicated totals after joining JDT1, and do not mix the header total with line debit or credit movements.

Memo.description: Text description cannot be used as a stable association key.

Number.description: Entry display number; use Series+Number to distinguish the number within the series. Number single column cannot be used to replace TransId association.

Project.description: Project code for the journal entry header, joined to OPRJ.PrjCode and stored separately from JDT1.Project. Changing the header project does not automatically change line projects; never use it to backfill line projects.

Ref1.description: The first reference text of the entry header; the value is affected by the reference field mapping configuration and is not fixedly interpreted as an invoice number, order number or installment number, and is not a stable associated key. The database defines 200 characters, and the old DI attribute length copy is not used as a truncation rule for this model.

Ref2.description: The second reference text of the entry header; the value is affected by the reference field mapping configuration and is not fixedly interpreted as an invoice number, order number or installment number, and is not a stable associated key. The database defines 200 characters, and the old DI attribute length copy is not used as a truncation rule for this model.

Ref3.description: The third reference text of the entry header; the value is affected by the reference field mapping configuration and is not fixedly interpreted as an invoice number, order number or installment number, and is not a stable associated key. The database defines 200 characters, and the old DI attribute length copy is not used as a truncation rule for this model.

RefDate.description: The header posting date is separate from the TaxDate document date, DueDate expiration date, and CreateDate creation date; see also JDT1 for the row date.

Series.description: Shows the series the number belongs to.

StornoDate.description: DI specifies the date when the reverse transaction was created; it cannot be judged that reversal has been executed based on this date alone.

StornoToTr.description: reversal related value; direction and effective value must be verified according to on-site samples.

SysTotal.description: The total amount of entry header system currency, currency comes from the same company OADM.SysCurrncy; maintain the header granularity and do not repeat the accumulation after the header row is connected.

TaxDate.description: The header document date is not an alias of posting date; the row document date also refers to JDT1.TaxDate.

TransCode.description: User-defined classification code; different from source object type TransType.

TransCurr.description: The entry head transaction currency mark; the line foreign currency cannot unconditionally replace JDT1.FCCurrency, nor can it be inferred from it that there is only one type of foreign currency in the entire entry.

TransId.description: The internal primary key of the entry is used to connect JDT1.TransId and TransId of the source business document; it is not the source document DocEntry, nor the display number Number.

TransType.description: String source object type, such as 13A/R invoice, 18A/P invoice, 24 receipt, 46 payment, 30 journal entry. 30 does not prove that it was entered manually by the user, API can also be created; combined with CreatedBy to trace the source.

UpdateDate.description: System record update date.

omrc.description: The manufacturer code and name master data are related through FirmCode of the material master data.

oocr.description: Each allocation rule is coded in one line; the rule is different from the cost center, the allocation details are in OCR1, and the specific cost center is in OPRC. Allocation rules must not be treated directly as cost centers.

opch.description: A/P invoice header, keyed by DocEntry. Includes A/P reserve invoices; distinguish goods receipt PO sources, down-payment drawdowns, and landed costs.

CANCELED.description: Y=Cancelled document; N=Not canceled; C=Cancelled voucher. Independent of the open and closed status; business statistics exclude whether to cancel or retain reversal must be explicitly specified.

CardCode.description: Supplier code, associated supplier master data.

CardName.description: Supplier name, used for supplier dimension analysis.

Comments.description: Business remark text; cannot replace the structured basic document source relationship.

CreateDate.description: Record creation date; not the actual occurrence of the business or posting date.

DiscPrcnt.description: The discount percentage for the entire document, separate from the detail line discount.

DocCur.description: Document currency; line price currency and base currency, system currency amount columns still need to be identified separately.

DocDate.description: posting date of the document; used separately with TaxDate document date, CreateDate creation date.

DocDueDate.description: A/P invoice payment due date; not payment completion. Does not replace installment-level due dates.

DocEntry.description: The internal primary key of this table; this key is used for association and cannot be replaced by the displayed order number DocNum.

DocManClsd.description: Whether the A/P invoice was closed manually, preserving Y/N/U unknown; not evidence of payment or settlement.

DocNum.description: The business displays the order number; the number series and document type affect uniqueness and are not used as cross-table unique keys.

DocRate.description: The exchange rate recorded in the document; the conversion direction and local currency/foreign currency basis should be consistent with the company configuration.

DocStatus.description: O is open, C is closed; closed is not equivalent to cancellation, and this field alone cannot be used to judge the completion of payment or logistics.

DocTotal.description: Saved LC document total; not amount paid or inventory cost. Do not repeat after joins to item, expense or drawdown rows.

DocTotalFC.description: Total amount of document header foreign currency; group by DocCur, and prevent repeated accumulation of detailed connections.

DocTotalSy.description: The total amount of the document header is system currency; the amount of local currency or foreign currency cannot be mixed.

DocType.description: I=item, S=service. Preserve service rows even when no item master record matches.

isIns.description: Y identifies an A/P reserve invoice: accounting liability precedes actual inventory quantity and value. Subsequent goods receipt completes logistics; use InvntSttus, not down payment or paid status.

ObjType.description: This document object type code is distinguished from the source line BaseType. The actual database type must be verified.

PaidFC.displayName: Cumulative Amount Received And Paid (Foreign Currency)
PaidFC.description: Current cumulative amount received or paid in foreign currency; use by currency, not as a foreign-currency unpaid balance. Stored separately from PaidSumFc; do not assume equivalence or equality, or automatically use as the deduction in a general open-payables formula.

PaidSys.displayName: Cumulative Amount Received And Paid (System Currency)
PaidSys.description: Current cumulative amount received or paid in system currency. Stored separately from PaidSumSc; do not assume equivalence or equality, or automatically use as the deduction in a general open-payables formula.

PaidToDate.displayName: Cumulative Amount Received And Paid (Local Currency)
PaidToDate.description: Current cumulative amount received or paid in local currency; not a payment movement for a specified historical period. Stored separately from PaidSum; do not assume equivalence or equality, or automatically use as the deduction in a general open-payables formula.

SlpCode.description: Sales/Purchasing employee code saved on this record, linked to OSLP.SlpCode. Distinct from document owner and requester; do not replace with the current vendor assignment.

TaxDate.description: Document or tax date, separate from posting DocDate and creation CreateDate. Confirm localization use; not an actual payment date.

TotalExpns.description: Saved total document additional expenses in the stated currency, not only transport; do not add again to a DocTotal already including them.

TransId.description: Accounting entry number; financial posting verification must be traced along this key, and commercial prices are not used to replace accounting amounts.

UpdateDate.description: Record update date; not business posting date.

VatSum.description: tax amount.

CurSource.description: L=local currency, S=system currency, C=business partner currency; C does not mean foreign currency. Use DocCur for document currency without changing each amount column role.

Project.description: Project code saved on this record, linked to OPRJ. Keep header and row projects separate.

OwnerCode.description: Document owner employee key linked to OHEM.empID; distinct from the purchasing employee and requester.

VatSumFC.description: Saved tax amount (fc) in the stated currency; do not recompute from current tax rates or double count across grains.

VatSumSy.description: Saved tax amount (sc) in the stated currency; do not recompute from current tax rates or double count across grains.

DiscSumFC.description: Saved document discount in the stated currency; separate from row discounts and must not be deducted twice.

DiscSumSy.description: Saved document discount in the stated currency; separate from row discounts and must not be deducted twice.

TotalExpFC.description: Saved total document additional expenses in the stated currency, not only transport; do not add again to a DocTotal already including them.

TotalExpSC.description: Saved total document additional expenses in the stated currency, not only transport; do not add again to a DocTotal already including them.

RoundDif.description: Saved document rounding difference in the stated currency; do not recompute from display precision.

RoundDifFC.description: Saved document rounding difference in the stated currency; do not recompute from display precision.

RoundDifSy.description: Saved document rounding difference in the stated currency; do not recompute from display precision.

InvntSttus.description: O=warehouse open, C=warehouse closed. Distinguishes reserve invoice logistics from financial status; not a payment status.

PaidSum.description: Current saved total paid sum at invoice-header grain. The unsuffixed currency is assumed to be company local currency (OADM.MainCurncy) from the three-currency naming convention, pending verification. Independent of PaidToDate, not an alias or substitute; update rules for payments, reconciliations, credit memos and reversals remain unconfirmed. Do not use directly for a general open-payables formula, period payments or historical balances.

PaidSumFc.description: Current saved total paid sum in foreign currency at invoice-header grain. Verify currency applicability with DocCur; zero or null on a local-currency invoice does not prove non-payment. Independent of PaidFC, not an alias or substitute; update rules for payments, reconciliations, credit memos and reversals remain unconfirmed. Do not use directly for a general open-payables formula, period payments or historical balances, or recompute at current exchange rates.

PaidSumSc.description: Current saved total paid sum in system currency at invoice-header grain; currency is identified by OADM.SysCurrncy. Independent of PaidSys, not an alias or substitute; update rules for payments, reconciliations, credit memos and reversals remain unconfirmed. Do not use directly for a general open-payables formula, period payments or historical balances, mix with other currencies, or recompute at current exchange rates.

opdn.description: Document header granularity, primary key DocEntry. Purchase receipt document (GRPO); different from general inventory receipt OIGN, also different from A/P invoice.

CANCELED.description: Y=Cancelled document; N=Not canceled; C=Cancelled voucher. Independent of the open and closed status; business statistics exclude whether to cancel or retain reversal must be explicitly specified.

CardName.description: Supplier name, used for supplier dimension analysis.

Comments.description: Business remark text; cannot replace the structured basic document source relationship.

DiscPrcnt.description: The discount percentage for the entire document, separate from the detail line discount.

DocCur.description: Document currency; line price currency and base currency, system currency amount columns still need to be identified separately.

DocDate.description: posting date of the document; used separately with TaxDate document date, CreateDate creation date.

DocDueDate.description: Saved GRPO due/delivery date, not vendor payment due or actual payment date. Use DocDate for receipt posting.

DocEntry.description: The internal primary key of this table; this key is used for association and cannot be replaced by the displayed order number DocNum.

DocNum.description: The business displays the order number; the number series and document type affect uniqueness and are not used as cross-table unique keys.

DocRate.description: The exchange rate recorded in the document; the conversion direction and local currency/foreign currency basis should be consistent with the company configuration.

DocStatus.description: O is open, C is closed; closed is not equivalent to cancellation, and this field alone cannot be used to judge the completion of payment or logistics.

DocTotal.description: Saved LC document total; not amount paid or inventory cost. Do not repeat after joins to item, expense or drawdown rows.

DocTotalFC.description: Total amount of document header foreign currency; group by DocCur, and prevent repeated accumulation of detailed connections.

DocTotalSy.description: The total amount of the document header is system currency; the amount of local currency or foreign currency cannot be mixed.

DocType.description: I=item, S=service. Preserve service rows even when no item master record matches.

ObjType.description: This document object type code is distinguished from the source line BaseType. The actual database type must be verified.

SlpCode.description: Sales/Purchasing employee code saved on this record, linked to OSLP.SlpCode. Distinct from document owner and requester; do not replace with the current vendor assignment.

TaxDate.description: Document or tax date, separate from posting DocDate and creation CreateDate. Confirm localization use; not an actual payment date.

TotalExpns.description: Saved total document additional expenses in the stated currency, not only transport; do not add again to a DocTotal already including them.

TransId.description: Association OJDT.TransId; document internal key DocEntry is not equivalent to entry key.

UpdateDate.description: Record update date; not business posting date.

VatSumSy.description: Saved tax amount (sc) in the stated currency; do not recompute from current tax rates or double count across grains.

RoundDifFC.description: Saved document rounding difference in the stated currency; do not recompute from display precision.

opor.description: Document header granularity, primary key DocEntry. Business documents for ordering from suppliers; order, open, purchase receipt and payable invoicing have different granularities.

CancelDate.description: Purchase order cutoff after which vendor shipping is disallowed; not the actual cancellation date. Separate from expected receipt DocDueDate.

CANCELED.description: Y=Canceled document; N=Not cancelled. Independent from the open and closed status; business statistics exclude cancellation or retention reversal must be explicitly specified.

oqut.description: Corresponds to the Service Layer sales entity Quotations (ObjType=23); the physical table is OQUT. Document header granularity, primary key DocEntry. Quotation scenario; does not directly represent actual deliveries, revenue, or inventory postings. The amounts are saved as local currency, foreign currency, and system currency basis respectively: currency of DocTotal is the same as company database OADM.MainCurncy, DocTotalSy is OADM.SysCurrncy; foreign currency of the document DocTotalFC is explained according to this table DocCur and summarized according to currency. DocCur can also be equal to local currency, not the unified currency for all amount columns. The total amount of the document, line amount are used separately; the first amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting multiple lines. CurSource represents the source selection of currency. See the field description for the value; the LC/FC/SC definition of each amount column will not be switched accordingly. The local currency and system currency codes are always read by the same company database OADM. This object exposes no verified payment or receivable-balance measure. Trace subsequent down payments, receivable documents and actual payments as separate business facts. Quotation tax also depends on the company setting for including tax in quotations. Zero tax alone does not prove a tax-exempt customer or item, and current settings cannot reconstruct historical quotation tax. See QUT1.LineType for regular versus alternative row scope.

CANCELED.description: Cancellation role: N=Uncancelled quotation; Y=Cancelled original quotation; C=Cancellation document mark. Standard quotation cancellation only cancels the original quotation and does not create a reverse cancellation quotation. Combined with DocStatus: N/O=not canceled but open, N/C=not canceled but closed; Y means canceled and will not be changed due to open or closed status. DocStatus=C (closing) cannot be regarded as CANCELED=C (cancel document).

CardCode.description: Business partner code of the quotation recipient, who may be a customer or a lead. Joins OCRD.CardCode; do not unconditionally restrict current OCRD.CardType to C.

CardName.description: Customer or lead name saved on the quotation. Preserve the historical document name rather than replacing it with the current business partner name.

Comments.description: Business remark text; cannot replace the structured basic document source relationship.

CreateDate.description: Record creation date; not the actual occurrence of the business or posting date.

DiscPrcnt.description: The discount percentage for the entire document, separate from the detail line discount.

DiscSum.description: The discount amount of the document header is used separately with the discount percentage and line discount price of line DiscPrcnt, and the line discount is not deducted repeatedly. currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy, and does not press DocCur or line Currency to assign currency to this column. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

DiscSumFC.description: The discount amount of the document header is used separately with the discount percentage and line discount price of line DiscPrcnt, and the line discount is not deducted repeatedly. Normal foreign currency documents interpret currency according to this table DocCur. This mapping is a combined interpretation of field family and document currency rules; the line price Currency cannot be used instead, and cross-documents must be grouped according to currency. The FC column of the local currency document may not be applicable, and the business amount cannot be determined to be zero due to zero or null values. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

DiscSumSy.description: The discount amount of the document header is used separately with the discount percentage and line discount price of line DiscPrcnt, and the line discount is not deducted repeatedly. currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, using the saved amount and not recalculating according to the current exchange rate. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

CurSource.description: Source of document currency: L=local currency, S=system currency, C=business partner currency. C is not equal to foreign currency identification, the actual document currency reads DocCur and is compared with company local currency. The local currency and system currency codes read the same company database OADM.MainCurncy and OADM.SysCurrncy respectively. This field does not change the LC/FC/SC basis defined in each amount column, nor does it replace the line price Currency.

DocCur.description: Actual document currency code, which may equal company local currency. CurSource selects its source; C=business partner currency does not itself mean foreign currency. For applicable foreign-currency documents, DocTotalFC uses this currency. DocTotal uses OADM.MainCurncy from the same company database, and DocTotalSy uses OADM.SysCurrncy. Line Currency describes prices and does not assign a common currency to every amount column.

DocDate.description: posting date of the document; used separately with TaxDate document date, CreateDate creation date.

DocDueDate.description: The date a sales quotation is valid for is not the date payment is due or the date of actual delivery.

DocEntry.description: The internal primary key of this table; this key is used for association and cannot be replaced by the displayed order number DocNum.

DocNum.description: The business displays the order number; the number series and document type affect uniqueness and are not used as cross-table unique keys.

DocRate.description: The exchange rate recorded in the document; the conversion direction and local currency/foreign currency basis should be consistent with the company configuration.

DocStatus.description: Quotation open ing and closing status, only O=open, C=closed. Combined with CANCELED: N/O=open quotation has not been cancelled, N/C=closed quotation has not been cancelled; CANCELED=Y means that the quotation has been cancelled, and DocStatus cannot be used to judge cancellation. The closed quotation is not equal to the transaction or income; whether the closed quotation is allowed to be copied is also controlled by the document settings. API property DocumentStatus uses bost_Open/bost_Close (ordinals 0/1) for open/closed status. SQL filters on this column still use O/C, never API names or ordinals; other shared enum members are not added as valid column values. Undefined values remain unverified.

DocTotal.description: The total amount of document header local currency and currency are the same as company database OADM.MainCurncy; even if DocCur is foreign currency, this column basis will not be changed. The total document amount must be combined with applicable taxes, whole order discounts, fees and rounding explanations, and does not equal tax-exclusive revenue, inventory costs or a simple total of line amount. The details cannot be accumulated repeatedly after being connected.

DocTotalFC.description: The total amount of the document header is foreign currency. For normal foreign currency documents, use this table DocCur to interpret currency and group them; local currency documents use DocTotal. It cannot be assumed that there is no business amount just because this column is zero or empty. The total amount of the document must be combined with applicable taxes, whole order discounts, fees and rounding explanations, and does not equal tax-exclusive revenue, inventory costs or a simple total of line amount. The details cannot be accumulated repeatedly after being connected.

DocTotalSy.description: The total amount of document header system currency, currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, not DocCur or line Currency; use the saved amount and do not recalculate according to the current exchange rate. The total document amount must be combined with applicable taxes, whole order discounts, fees and rounding explanations, and does not equal tax-exclusive revenue, inventory costs or a simple total of line amount. The details cannot be accumulated repeatedly after being connected.

ordn.description: Corresponds to the Service Layer sales entity Returns (ObjType=16); the physical table is ORDN. Document header granularity, primary key DocEntry. Sales return document; traceability to the order is usually through the delivery line, and there is no direct source edge for the general BaseType=17. The amounts are saved as local currency, foreign currency, and system currency basis respectively: currency of DocTotal takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy, DocTotalSy takes OADM.SysCurrncy; foreign currency of the document DocTotalFC is explained according to this table DocCur and summarized according to currency. DocCur can also be equal to local currency, not the unified currency for all amount columns. The total amount of the document, line amount are used separately; the first amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting multiple lines. CurSource represents the source selection of currency. This object exposes no verified payment or receivable-balance measure. Trace subsequent down payments, receivable documents and actual payments as separate business facts.

CANCELED.description: Cancellation role: N=an ordinary document that has not been canceled; Y=the canceled original document; C=a separate cancellation document created by the system to reverse the original document. After cancellation, the original document has Y and the cancellation document has C; both have DocStatus=C (closed). N does not mean open: combine it with DocStatus to distinguish N/O from N/C.

CardCode.description: Customer code, associated with customer master data.

CardName.description: Customer name, used for customer dimension analysis.

Comments.description: Business remark text; cannot replace the structured basic document source relationship.

CreateDate.description: Record creation date; not the actual occurrence of the business or posting date.

DiscPrcnt.description: The discount percentage for the entire document, separate from the detail line discount.

DiscSum.description: The discount amount of the document header is used separately with the discount percentage and line discount price of line DiscPrcnt, and the line discount is not deducted repeatedly. currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy, and does not press DocCur or line Currency to assign currency to this column. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

DiscSumFC.description: The discount amount of the document header is used separately with the discount percentage and line discount price of line DiscPrcnt, and the line discount is not deducted repeatedly. Normal foreign currency documents interpret currency according to this table DocCur. This mapping is a combined interpretation of field family and document currency rules; the line price Currency cannot be used instead, and cross-documents must be grouped according to currency. The FC column of the local currency document may not be applicable, and the business amount cannot be determined to be zero due to zero or null values. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

DiscSumSy.description: The discount amount of the document header is used separately with the discount percentage and line discount price of line DiscPrcnt, and the line discount is not deducted repeatedly. currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, using the saved amount and not recalculating according to the current exchange rate. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

CurSource.description: Source of document currency: L=local currency, S=system currency, C=business partner currency. The local currency and system currency codes read the same company database OADM.MainCurncy and OADM.SysCurrncy respectively. This field does not change the LC/FC/SC basis defined in each amount column, nor does it replace the line price Currency.

DocCur.description: Actual document currency code, which may equal company local currency. CurSource selects its source; C=business partner currency does not itself mean foreign currency. For applicable foreign-currency documents, DocTotalFC uses this currency. DocTotal uses OADM.MainCurncy from the same company database, and DocTotalSy uses OADM.SysCurrncy. Line Currency describes prices and does not assign a common currency to every amount column.

DocDate.description: posting date of the document; used separately with TaxDate document date, CreateDate creation date.

DocDueDate.description: The database reference is defined as due date; the specific interface and regionalized use of this document still need to be verified and will not be interpreted as the payment due date, actual delivery date or payment receipt date by default.

DocEntry.description: The internal primary key of this table; this key is used for association and cannot be replaced by the displayed order number DocNum.

DocNum.description: The business displays the order number; the number series and document type affect uniqueness and are not used as cross-table unique keys.

DocRate.description: The exchange rate recorded in the document; the conversion direction and local currency/foreign currency basis should be consistent with the company configuration.

DocStatus.description: Document open and closed status, only O=open, C=closed. API property DocumentStatus uses bost_Open/bost_Close (ordinals 0/1) for open/closed status. SQL filters on this column still use O/C, never API names or ordinals; other shared enum members are not added as valid column values. Undefined values remain unverified.

DocTotal.description: The total amount of document header local currency and currency are the same as company database OADM.MainCurncy; even if DocCur is foreign currency, this column basis will not be changed. The details cannot be accumulated repeatedly after being connected.

DocTotalFC.description: The total amount of the document header is foreign currency. It cannot be assumed that there is no business amount just because this column is zero or empty. DocEntry.description: The internal primary key of this table; this key is used for association and cannot be replaced by the displayed order number DocNum.

DocNum.description: The business displays the order number; the number series and document type affect uniqueness and are not used as cross-table unique keys.

DocRate.description: The exchange rate recorded in the document; the conversion direction and local currency/foreign currency basis should be consistent with the company configuration.

DocStatus.description: Document open and closed status, only O=open, C=closed. Judgment based on CANCELED: N/O=not canceled but open, N/C=not canceled but closed; after completing the reverse cancellation, original document is Y/C, and the new cancellation order is C/C. C in DocStatus means closure, which is different from C in CANCELED, which means cancellation document; closed itself cannot prove that everything has been handed in or collected. API property DocumentStatus uses bost_Open/bost_Close (ordinals 0/1) for open/closed status. SQL filters on this column still use O/C, never API names or ordinals; other shared enum members are not added as valid column values. Undefined values remain unverified.

DocTotal.description: The total amount of document header local currency and currency are the same as company database OADM.MainCurncy; even if DocCur is foreign currency, this column basis will not be changed. The total document amount must be combined with applicable taxes, whole order discounts, fees and rounding explanations, and does not equal tax-exclusive revenue, inventory costs or a simple total of line amount. When there is a prepayment deduction, the impact of the deduction on the total amount should also be checked, and this column should not be defaulted to the value before deduction. The details cannot be accumulated repeatedly after being connected.

DocTotalFC.description: The total amount of the document header is foreign currency. For normal foreign currency documents, use this table DocCur to interpret currency and group them; local currency documents use DocTotal. It cannot be assumed that there is no business amount just because this column is zero or empty. The total amount of the document must be combined with applicable taxes, whole order discounts, fees and rounding explanations, and does not equal tax-exclusive revenue, inventory costs or a simple total of line amount. When there is a prepayment deduction, the impact of the deduction on the total amount should also be checked, and this column should not be defaulted to the value before deduction. The details cannot be accumulated repeatedly after being connected.

DocTotalSy.description: The total amount of document header system currency, currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, not DocCur or line Currency; use the saved amount and do not recalculate according to the current exchange rate. The total document amount must be combined with applicable taxes, whole order discounts, fees and rounding explanations, and does not equal tax-exclusive revenue, inventory costs or a simple total of line amount. When there is a prepayment deduction, the impact of the deduction on the total amount should also be checked, and this column should not be defaulted to the value before deduction. The details cannot be accumulated repeatedly after being connected.

DocType.description: I=material document, S=service document; the document object type code is different from ObjType. The service line does not need ItemCode and should be interpreted in conjunction with the lines Dscription and AcctCode. The service amount cannot be excluded due to lack of material coding. API enum members dDocument_Items/dDocument_Service (ordinals 0/1) are reference mappings only. SQL filters use I/S, never enum names or ordinals. Undefined values remain unverified.

GrosProfit.description: The gross profit amount of the document.

JrnlMemo.description: Summary of accounting documents generated by document posting.

NumAtCard.description: Customer order number or external reference number.

ObjType.description: This document object type code is distinguished from the source line BaseType. The actual database type must be verified. This table represents CreditNotes, with object type code 14; it is distinct from DocType I/S and does not identify the source object.

PaidFC.displayName: Cumulative Amount Received And Paid (Foreign Currency)
PaidFC.description: Current cumulative amount paid or received in foreign currency. For foreign currency documents, the currency is this table's DocCur; group by DocCur across documents. This is not the foreign currency unpaid balance or the payment movement for a specified historical period. For local currency documents, use PaidToDate.

PaidSys.displayName: Cumulative Amount Received And Paid (System Currency)
PaidSys.description: The current cumulative amount of receipts and payments in the document is system currency, currency is taken as OADM.SysCurrncy; it is not the unpaid amount or the receipts and payments in the specified historical period posted movement. The same currency basis must be used when comparing with the total amount of the document.

PaidToDate.displayName: Cumulative Amount Received And Paid (Local Currency)
PaidToDate.description: The current cumulative amount of receipts and payments in the document is local currency, and currency is equal to OADM.MainCurncy; it cannot be regarded as posted movement as the receipts and payments in the specified historical period, nor is it the unpaid amount. The same currency basis must be used when comparing with the total amount of the document.

ReqDate.description: Date on which the customer expects to receive the goods; not a cancellation date, posting date or actual receipt event. Interpret separately from DocDueDate and the line ShipDate planning values.

RoundDif.description: The difference between the original amount of the document and the amount after rounding; the recorded positive and negative values are retained and are not recalculated according to the currently displayed decimal places. currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy. Do not press DocCur or line Currency to assign currency to this column. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

RoundDifFC.description: The difference between the original amount of the document and the amount after rounding; the recorded positive and negative values are retained and are not recalculated according to the currently displayed decimal places. Normal foreign currency documents interpret currency according to this table DocCur. This mapping is a combined interpretation of the field family and the document currency rules; the line price Currency cannot be used instead, and cross-documents must be grouped according to currency. The FC column of the local currency document may not be applicable, and the business amount cannot be determined to be zero due to zero or null values. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

RoundDifSy.description: The difference between the original amount of the document and the amount after rounding; the recorded positive and negative values are retained and are not recalculated according to the currently displayed decimal places. currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, using the saved amount and not recalculating according to the current exchange rate. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

Series.description: Document number series, associated with NNM1.Series; interpreted with DocNum to display the number, and cannot replace DocEntry as the internal key of the document.

SlpCode.description: Internal coding of salesperson, associated with salesperson master data.

TaxDate.description: The database reference is marked as the document date, FP2508 DI API is explained as the tax calculation or payment date; it is interpreted according to localization and actual business use, and is different from posting date DocDate.

TotalExpFC.description: Document surcharges or total freight charges are included in this document expense and do not represent all operating expenses of the enterprise; they are used separately with taxes, discounts and product line amount. Normal foreign currency documents interpret currency according to this table DocCur. This mapping is a combined interpretation of field family and document currency rules; the line price Currency cannot be used instead, and cross-documents must be grouped according to currency. The FC column of the local currency document may not be applicable, and the business amount cannot be determined to be zero due to zero or null values. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

TotalExpns.description: Document surcharges or total freight charges are included in this document expense and do not represent all operating expenses of the enterprise; they are used separately with taxes, discounts and product line amount. currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy, and does not press DocCur or line Currency to assign currency to this column. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

TotalExpSC.description: Document surcharges or total freight charges are included in this document expense and do not represent all operating expenses of the enterprise; they are used separately with taxes, discounts and product line amount. currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, using the saved amount and not recalculating according to the current exchange rate. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

TransId.description: Association OJDT.TransId; document internal key DocEntry is not equivalent to entry key.

UpdateDate.description: Record update date; not business posting date.

VatSum.description: The header tax amount of the document is recorded according to the applicable tax system; the header tax amount may include expense tax and is not preset to be equal to the sum of ordinary sales tax amounts. currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy. Do not press DocCur or line Currency to assign currency to this column. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

VatSumFC.description: The header tax amount of the document is recorded according to the applicable tax system; the header tax amount may include expense tax and is not preset to be equal to the sum of ordinary sales tax amounts. Normal foreign currency documents interpret currency according to this table DocCur. This mapping is a combined interpretation of the field family and the document currency rules; the line price Currency cannot be used instead, and cross-documents must be grouped according to currency. The FC column of the local currency document may not be applicable, and the business amount cannot be determined to be zero due to zero or null values. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

VatSumSy.description: The header tax amount of the document is recorded according to the applicable tax system; the header tax amount may include expense tax and is not preset to be equal to the sum of ordinary sales tax amounts. currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, using the saved amount and not recalculating according to the current exchange rate. The initial amount cannot be accumulated repeatedly after connecting the details.

orsb.description: Each resource group is coded in one line; resource classification, unit and other configurations are provided. The group default configuration is not the resource consumption flow rate or the actual cost of the work order.

createDate.description: The official mark is Creation Date - History; only the field meaning is reserved and is not used as the date of production business occurrence.

DataSource.description: The source system records channel flags, such as DI API or Service Layer; not the business source document type.

Locked.description: N can be modified, Y is locked; it is not a production order closed state.

logInstanc.description: Official tags are Log Instance - History; not resource quantity, frequency, or cost.

ResGrpCod.description: Resource group primary key; resources are related through ORSC.ResGrpCod.

ResGrpNam.description: Current resource classification name; not equivalent to material group name.

ResType.description: M machine, L manual, O other; the resource type default value can be provided by the selected group, and the specific resource still reads ORSC.ResType.

ResUoM.description: The capacity of the resource group is configured as unit of measure; the actual resource unit still reads ORSC.UnitOfMsr, and historical unit conversion is not inferred.

updateDate.description: The of ficial markings are Date of Update - History; not the resource consumption date.

UserSign.description: SAP User-internal identifier; not directly interpretable as resource owner or labor hours.

orsc.description: Internally encodes one row of current master data for each resource; including machine, labor, and other resources. Resource capacity units and consumption are separate from material inventory quantities, and current resource costs may not substitute for historical work order actual costs.

Deleted.description: Y Yes, N No; the source system status is retained and historical transaction associations are not automatically deleted accordingly.

DfltWH.description: The default warehouse configuration of resources; does not represent the actual warehouse used by all work orders.

frozenFor.description: Y is yes, N is no; it is matched with the deactivation period and enabled configuration, and does not directly replace the work order status.

IssueMthd.description: B backflush, M manual; the current default consumption method, the specific work order is still subject to the document line configuration and execution record.

PrchseRes.description: Y is yes, N is no; the procurement flag of resource master data is not procurement posted movement.

ProdRes.description: Y is yes, N is no; the resource is configured for production purposes and does not prove that the specified work order has been consumed.

ResCode.description: The unique internal key of resource master data; associated resource components use this column and do not need to display the number VisResCode instead.

ResGrpCod.description: The resource group it belongs to is associated with ORSB.ResGrpCod; it is not the material group code.

ResName.description: Current resource master data description; historical production document descriptions may be different.

ResType.description: M Machine, L Labor, O Other; different from production component type 290.

SellRes.description: Y is yes, N is no; the sales flag of resource master data is not sales posted movement.

UnitOfMsr.description: The unit of expression of resource capacity, such as machine cycles, hours or minutes; it cannot be used as a mixed sum of materials inventory UoM.

validFor.description: Y is yes, N is no; judging the availability on a certain day requires checking the validity period and deactivation configuration, and the historical availability status cannot be directly inferred.

VisResCode.description: Interface resource number; DI API VisCode, which can be generated by the numbering rule and distinguished from the internal key ResCode.

ortt.description: each row is a date with currency, a composite primary key (RateDate, Currency). Date exchange rate does not automatically replace document history accounting exchange rate; field availability must be verified on target company database.

Currency.description: Co-match with RateDate; only connect by currency to extend one transaction to multiple dates.

DataSource.description: The data import or interface source cannot prove that exchange rate is used in a certain document.

Rate.description: For the exchange rate data of the company local currency; the conversion direction is verified by combining OADM.DirectRate and the reading method.

RateDate.description: It forms a unique key with Currency; the reporting date of exchange rate is not necessarily equal to the document posting date.

UserSign.description: User internal identification, not exchange rate effective date.

oslp.description: Salesperson, used for SAP Business One business analysis, operating analysis and intelligent Q&A.

EmpID.description: The number to which the employee master data is associated.

GroupCode.description: The group code to which the salesperson belongs.

Locked.description: Whether the salesperson is locked out.

SlpCode.description: Internal coding of salesperson, associated with salesperson master data.

osrn.description: Each AbsEntry has one piece of master data; ItemCode and SysNumber have unique keys, and the display numbers are not individually unique. No warehouse granularity, not used as warehouse inventory balance or historical inventory.

Balance.description: It cannot be regarded as a historical valuation balance without verification.

CostTotal.description: Affected by the valuation configuration; does not represent the cost of a certain bill of materials.

DistNumber.description: Business display number; the official index is not guaranteed to be unique alone or in combination with materials.

ItemCode.description: Together with SysNumber, it forms the unique key of the system.

MnfDate.description: The manufacturing date of the batch or serial master data is not inventory posting date.

Quantity.description: It does not have warehouse or historical time point granularity and cannot replace warehouse batch serial inventory quantities.

Status.description: Serial number status: 0=Available, 1=Unavailable, 2=Allocated. This status alone does not identify the warehouse that currently holds the serial number.

SysNumber.description: Must be used in the context of material and management types.

UpdateDate.description: The date the master data was last updated.

ougp.description: Each unit group is internally marked with one line; the base unit is defined, and the specific conversion relationship is in UGP1.

CreateDate.description: The unit group creation date is not the starting date for the conversion to take effect.

UpdateDate.description: The current record update time, the complete historical conversion version is not provided.

ouom.description: Each unit is internally identified with one row; the unit code has unique constraints, and the name is not used as an associated key.

CreateDate.description: Unit master data creation date.

IntSymbol.description: Unit symbol, does not replace internal primary key.

UomCode.description: Unit business code, the official list has a unique index.

UomEntry.description: Unit primary key.

UomName.description: Display name, not used as relationship key.

UpdateDate.description: Unit master data update date.

ovpm.description: each row is a payment receipt, with the primary key DocEntry. Supports customers, suppliers, and account categories; multiple invoices, partial payments, or pending accounts can be made at one time. The initial amount is measured separately from the application line and reconciliation event.

CancelDate.description: The cancellation date is independent of the original posting date; the DI Cancel description uses the original document date, and it cannot be assumed that the cancellation is always the execution day.

Canceled.description: N is normal, Y has been canceled, and C has canceled the document; it cannot be uniformly filtered and claimed to be general ledger net posted movement.

CardCode.description: Class C/S can be associated with OCRD; class A is not forced to be interpreted as a business partner.

CardName.description: The name of the payment record.

NoDocSumSy.description: On-Account amount (SC) at payment-header grain. Currency is the same company OADM.SysCurrncy; keep separate from LC and FC amounts.
