qut1.description: Corresponds to DocumentLine in Quotations.DocumentLines; the physical table is QUT1. The same shared type maps to different tables under other parent documents. document line granularity, primary key (DocEntry, LineNum). Quotation scenario; does not directly represent actual deliveries, revenue, or inventory postings. Amount basis: LineTotal is local currency line amount excluding tax, currency is the company database OADM local currency (OADM.MainCurncy); TotalSumSy is system currency line amount, currency is OADM.SysCurrncy; foreign currency document TotalFrgn uses header DocCur (OQUT.DocCur), and OQUT.DocEntry is related to this line DocEntry. this line Currency is the price currency, not the unified currency for all line amount. The amounts across currency foreign currency are summarized separately; the total amount in the first section cannot be directly equivalent to line amount excluding tax. For service lines, current open amounts are OpenSum/OpenSumFC/OpenSumSys. TreeType identifies BOM roles. Use the project and sales employee saved on the line, without substituting header or current master values. A quotation line does not post inventory. InvQty expresses the quoted quantity in inventory units. Distinguish regular and alternative rows with LineType; regular line amounts are after line discount and before document discount allocation.

AcctCode.description: document line account code, associated with OACT.AcctCode; the service line can explain the business through the account and description. The presence of an account code does not prove that the document has generated accounting postings or that the amount has been recognized as revenue.

BaseEntry.description: Marketing document source internal key; target DocEntry is joined only if the source type matches.

BaseLine.description: Marketing document source line number; forms a source triplet with BaseEntry and BaseType. References the stored LineNum of the source document, not the source collection API array index or UI display order.

BaseType.description: Only the this line direct source type is recorded; it must be connected together with BaseEntry and BaseLine, and the direct edge cannot be made according to the flow chart. SQL predicates use the source object type numeric code, never an API entity name; supported direct sources follow the declared relationships.

Currency.description: currency for this line price is used to interpret price fields such as Price; it cannot be used to interpret LineTotal or TotalSumSy, which use OADM.MainCurncy and OADM.SysCurrncy respectively. foreign currency document line amount TotalFrgn is explained by OQUT.DocCur, line price currency and document currency must be read separately.

DiscPrcnt.description: The current discount percentage of document line is separate from the entire order discount.

DocDate.description: Business posting date; used with document date, due date and creation date respectively.

DocEntry.description: The internal key of the corresponding table header; and LineNum constitute the primary key of this table row.

Dscription.description: The material or service description saved by document line reflects the historical content of the document and cannot be replaced by the current material master data name; the service line belonging to OQUT.DocType=S does not have ItemCode.

GrossBuyPr.description: The base price used to calculate this line gross profit can be taken from the price list, latest purchase price, material cost, etc. based on gross profit settings. It is not a fixed actual purchase cost, nor can it be directly regarded as the inventory delivery cost; currency and the pricing unit need to be verified with applicable documents and settings.

GTotal.displayName: Total Line Tax Including Tax (Local Currency)
GTotal.description: document line is the tax-included total after taking line discounts into account, and is used separately from the tax-exclusive LineTotal series; it is not presumed that all header discounts, fees or prepayments have been allocated, nor is it directly equivalent to the total document header total. currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy. Do not press DocCur or line Currency to assign currency to this column. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

GTotalFC.displayName: Total Line Tax Including Tax (Foreign Currency)
GTotalFC.description: document line is the tax-included total after taking line discounts into account, and is used separately from the tax-exclusive LineTotal series; it is not presumed that all header discounts, fees or prepayments have been allocated, nor is it directly equivalent to the total document header total. Normal foreign currency documents interpret currency according to the OQUT.DocCur they belong to. This mapping is a combined interpretation of the field family and the document currency rules; the line price Currency cannot be used instead, and cross-documents must be grouped according to currency. The FC column of the local currency document may not be applicable, and the business amount cannot be determined to be zero due to zero or null values. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

GTotalSC.displayName: Total Line Tax Including Tax (System Currency)
GTotalSC.description: document line is the tax-included total after taking line discounts into account, and is used separately from the tax-exclusive LineTotal series; it is not presumed that all header discounts, fees or prepayments have been allocated, nor is it directly equivalent to the total document header total. currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, using the saved amount and not recalculating according to the current exchange rate. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

InvQty.description: The quantity represented by inventory unit of measure; unlike Quantity, whether an inventory movement is formed is still determined by the document and mark.

ItemCode.description: Material identification; identical materials cannot be proven to belong to the same order, work order, or source line.

LineNum.description: Participates in the composite primary key and BaseLine source connection; not the interface sort number VisOrder. Line numbers need not be contiguous and cannot be reconstructed from API collection array indexes.

LineStatus.description: O=Open; C=Close. Closing and canceling have different meanings; they are handled explicitly based on business issues, and valid and canceled documents cannot be mixed.

LineTotal.description: Excluding tax local currency line amount, currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy; does not change the Currency or header DocCur to currency basis. It is not equal to the posted amount of inventory valuation, nor can it be directly equal to the total amount of the document header, ignoring taxes, discounts and rounding differences. For regular quotation lines, the saved amount includes the line discount but does not allocate the document discount. Do not deduct the line discount again; determine alternative-row scope using LineType.

NumPerMsr.description: The unit of measure conversion value saved in this document line; historical analysis must not be directly overwritten with the current material master data conversion.

ObjType.description: The object type belonging to the current document cannot replace the BaseType explanation source.

OpenInvQty.description: Quantity of open expressed as inventory UoM; used for comparison with basis in stock, still in current status.

OpenQty.description: The current remaining quantity of open; it is not the balance at any historical point in time, nor can it be generally equal to the quantity that has not been shipped or invoiced.

Price.description: DI API defines Price as the unit price before tax; the database reference in this table is only marked as price, and the meaning after discount must be interpreted in conjunction with PriceBefDi, DiscPrcnt and pricing rules. It cannot be claimed that this table dictionary has directly stated it. The price currency is taken from this line Currency, and is interpreted according to the this line transaction pricing unit; it is checked with UomEntry/UomCode/unitMsr, UseBaseUn and NumPerMsr, and is not priced according to inventory UoM by default. It is not directly added as the business amount, nor can it be used as the inventory valuation unit price.

PriceAfVAT.displayName: Unit Price Including Tax After Line Discount
PriceAfVAT.description: The tax-included unit price after applying this line discount is not the tax-included price before discount. The price currency is taken from this line Currency, and is interpreted according to the this line transaction pricing unit; it is checked with UomEntry/UomCode/unitMsr, UseBaseUn and NumPerMsr, and is not priced according to inventory UoM by default. It is used separately with the pre-tax price, pre-discount price and line amount, and does not overwrite the historical value with the current tax rate and discount recalculation.

PriceBefDi.displayName: Unit Price Before Discount And Tax
PriceBefDi.description: The pre-tax unit price before this line discount is applied; this table column definition and the SAP unit price rule jointly determine the basis. The price currency is taken from this line Currency, and is interpreted according to the this line transaction pricing unit; it is checked with UomEntry/UomCode/unitMsr, UseBaseUn and NumPerMsr, and is not priced according to inventory UoM by default. Use separately with the discounted price and saved line amount.

Quantity.description: The quantity of sales or purchasing units in a document; the unit must be unified before totaling across documents and materials, and is not directly equivalent to the inventory UoM quantity.

Rate.description: The exchange rate saved by this line is used separately from the header document exchange rate DocRate; the applicable currency and conversion direction need to be verified, and the current daily exchange rate is not taken by default or the multiplication and division formulas are uniformly used.

ShipDate.description: this line delivery date field; different from the header posting date, whether actual delivery must be combined with the document type.

TargetType.description: The type code of the subsequent target document, used separately from the underlying source type BaseType. You cannot judge all delivery or invoicing status based on this field alone; subsequent quantities and amounts should be checked along the actual document source relationship.

TotalFrgn.description: foreign currency basis of line amount; foreign currency documents are interpreted by belonging to OQUT.DocCur, this line DocEntry is associated with OQUT.DocEntry, and cross-documents are grouped by DocCur. Row Currency only represents the price currency, and does not assign currency to this column accordingly; LineTotal is used for local currency documents, and the business amount is not judged to be zero based on the zero or empty value of this column. For regular quotation lines, the saved amount includes the line discount but does not allocate the document discount. Do not deduct the line discount again; determine alternative-row scope using LineType.

TotalSumSy.description: system currency basis and currency of line amount take the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy; it is not the unit price, the row Currency or header DocCur is not used as currency, and the saved amount is not recalculated according to the current exchange rate. For regular quotation lines, the saved amount includes the line discount but does not allocate the document discount. Do not deduct the line discount again; determine alternative-row scope using LineType.

unitMsr.description: this line unit of measure display name; used to explain Quantity.

UomCode.description: this line unit of measure code; different unit quantities cannot be added directly before consistency is verified.

UomEntry.description: this line unit of measure mark; should be used together with UomCode and the conversion value saved in the document.

UseBaseUn.description: this line inventory unit of measure mark; combined with Quantity, InvQty and unit code explanation.

VatSum.description: document line total tax, including standard tax and applicable equalization tax, can be manually adjusted; unlike LineVat series net tax, the saved value is not overwritten by the price multiplied by the tax rate. currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy. Do not press DocCur or line Currency to assign currency to this column. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

VatSumFrgn.description: document line total tax, including standard tax and applicable equalization tax, can be manually adjusted; unlike LineVat series net tax, the saved value is not overwritten by the price multiplied by the tax rate. Normal foreign currency documents interpret currency according to the OQUT.DocCur they belong to. This mapping is a combined interpretation of the field family and the document currency rules; the line price Currency cannot be used instead, and cross-documents must be grouped according to currency. The FC column of the local currency document may not be applicable, and the business amount cannot be determined to be zero due to zero or null values. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

VatSumSy.description: document line total tax, including standard tax and applicable equalization tax, can be manually adjusted; unlike LineVat series net tax, the saved value is not overwritten by the price multiplied by the tax rate. currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, and uses the saved amount, and does not recalculate according to the current exchange rate. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

WhsCode.description: Business lines correspond to warehouses; warehouses, storage locations and materials have different granularities.

Project.description: Project code saved on this line; joins OPRJ.PrjCode. Do not default to the header project or remove historical lines based on current project activity or validity. Distinguish an empty code from an unmatched project master record.

SlpCode.description: Sales employee code saved on this line; joins OSLP.SlpCode. Keep it separate from the header sales employee and the current customer master salesperson; do not force them to agree. Null, unassigned and unmatched values do not identify a default employee.

TreeType.description: Document line BOM role: N=not a BOM, A=assembly, S=sales BOM, I=sales BOM component, P=production BOM, T=template. Distinguishes parent and component roles; it does not define parent/child line keys or justify deleting all components or summing parent and component quantities indiscriminately. Interpret prices and quantities using actual roles and settings; investigate unknown values separately.

OpenSum.description: Only applicable to service document lines with parent OQUT.DocType=S. The current open business amount for this line, interpreted separately from LineStatus; OpenQty is not a monetary substitute. It is not a cash receipt, document receivable balance or historical aging value; do not overwrite it with quantity times current price. Currency comes from OADM.MainCurncy in the same company database.

OpenSumFC.description: Only applicable to service document lines with parent OQUT.DocType=S. The current open business amount for this line, interpreted separately from LineStatus; OpenQty is not a monetary substitute. It is not a cash receipt, document receivable balance or historical aging value; do not overwrite it with quantity times current price. Verify foreign-currency applicability and currency against the parent document, not the line price Currency; aggregate different currencies separately.

OpenSumSys.description: Only applicable to service document lines with parent OQUT.DocType=S. rct2.description: The application of each row one-time payment to the target document or transaction, compound key (DocNum, InvoiceId). This is the payment application details, not the complete internal reconciliation history.

AppliedFC.description: Stored FC amount on the target-document application row. Resolve the target by InvType and its currency; do not automatically assign payment-header DocCurr. A zero FC amount does not establish that no LC payment occurred.

AppliedSys.description: Application-row amount (SC), using the same company OADM.SysCurrncy. Explicitly declare the official precision 19,6; not equivalent to the full payment-header total.

DcntSum.description: Line discounts are applied, separate from the actual amount paid.

DocEntry.displayName: Internal Identifier Of The Object Being Paid
DocEntry.description: Diversion by InvType; sales or A/P invoice cannot be connected unconditionally.

DocLine.description: Row key; separate from installment number InstId and application row serial number InvoiceId.

DocNum.displayName: The Internal Identifier Of The Affiliated Payment
DocNum.description: The payment header of the candidate connection is DocEntry; the tag of SDK is Document Number, which needs to be verified by on-site counterexample before being enabled.

DocRate.description: The saved document is exchange rate.

DocTransId.displayName: Entry Number Of The Person Being Paid
DocTransId.description: The OJDT.TransId connected to the object being paid is not the entry number of the payment itself.

InstId.displayName: The Installment Number To Be Paid
InstId.description: The target invoice installment identifier is not equal to the product details LineNum.

InvoiceId.description: It forms the primary key with DocNum; it is not the internal number of the paid invoice.

InvType.description: String object type; 13/14/18/19/203/204, etc. refer to different documents respectively.

LinkDate.description: Database connection date. The attributes with the same name of DI are specific to Poland and mapped to DpmPosted; they are not directly mapped with the same name or used as general reconciliation.

ObjType.displayName: The Type Of Payment Object It Belongs To
ObjType.description: The payment type to which this line belongs; different from the target InvType.

SumApplied.description: The amount of this line applied to the target document is not equal to the total payment amount.

WtAppld.displayName: Local Currency Withholding Tax Application Amount
WtAppld.description: The amount of withholding tax applied cannot be omitted and then the cash and reconciliation amounts are forcibly aligned.

WtAppldFC.displayName: Foreign Currency Withholding Tax Application Amount

WtAppldSC.displayName: System Currency Withholding Tax Application Amount

RounddifFc.description: Stored rounding difference (FC) on the application row. Interpret with the target object and its currency role; do not automatically backfill the payment-header currency.

RounddifSc.description: Stored rounding difference (SC) on the application row; currency is the same company OADM.SysCurrncy. Does not establish a universal settlement identity.

ExpAppld.description: Freight amount applied to the target document (LC), using the same company OADM.MainCurncy; not actual carrier cost and not automatically an increment to SumApplied.

ExpAppldFC.description: Stored applied freight amount (FC) on the application row. Interpret using the target object and stored FC role rather than automatically assigning payment-header DocCurr.

ExpAppldSC.description: Stored applied freight amount (SC), using the same company OADM.SysCurrncy; distinct from freight tax and cash payment amounts.

rct4.description: each row is a subject collection and payment application, with composite keys (DocNum, LineId), applicable to the Account category; it is a different set of details from the invoice application RCT2/VPM2.

AcctName.description: Stored account-name snapshot on an account-payment row, preserved up to 200 characters. Do not replace it with the current OACT name or use it as a join key.

AmntBase.description: E does not include tax, I includes tax.

AppliedFC.description: Apply the amount to foreign currency of the account.

AppliedSys.description: Apply the amount to system currency of the account.

DocNum.displayName: The Internal Identifier Of The Affiliated Payment

GrossAmnt.description: Total including tax, separate from SumApplied.

Project.description: Project on the G/L account allocation line.

SumApplied.description: The amount applied to the account.

AcctCode.description: document line account code, associated with OACT.AcctCode; the service line can explain the business through the account and description. BaseEntry.description: Marketing document source internal key; target DocEntry is joined only if the source type matches.

BaseLine.description: Marketing document source line number; forms a source triplet with BaseEntry and BaseType. References the stored LineNum of the source document, not the source collection API array index or UI display order.

BaseType.description: Only the this line direct source type is recorded; it must be connected together with BaseEntry and BaseLine, and the direct edge cannot be made according to the flow chart. SQL predicates use the source object type numeric code, never an API entity name; supported direct sources follow the declared relationships.

Currency.description: currency for this line price is used to interpret price fields such as Price; it cannot be used to interpret LineTotal or TotalSumSy, which use OADM.MainCurncy and OADM.SysCurrncy respectively. foreign currency document line amount TotalFrgn is explained by ORDN.DocCur, line price currency and document currency must be read separately.

DiscPrcnt.description: The current discount percentage of document line is separate from the entire order discount.

DocDate.description: Business posting date; used with document date, due date and creation date respectively.

DocEntry.description: The internal key of the corresponding table header; and LineNum constitute the primary key of this table row.

Dscription.description: The material or service description saved by document line reflects the historical content of the document and cannot be replaced by the current material master data name; the service line belonging to ORDN.DocType=S does not have ItemCode.

GTotal.displayName: Total Line Tax Including Tax (Local Currency)
GTotal.description: document line is the tax-included total after taking line discounts into account, and is used separately from the tax-exclusive LineTotal series; it is not presumed that all header discounts, fees or prepayments have been allocated, nor is it directly equivalent to the total document header total. currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy. Do not press DocCur or line Currency to assign currency to this column. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

GTotalFC.displayName: Total Line Tax Including Tax (Foreign Currency)
GTotalFC.description: document line is the tax-included total after taking line discounts into account, and is used separately from the tax-exclusive LineTotal series; it is not presumed that all header discounts, fees or prepayments have been allocated, nor is it directly equivalent to the total document header total. Normal foreign currency documents interpret currency according to the ORDN.DocCur they belong to. This mapping is a combined interpretation of the field family and the document currency rules; the line price Currency cannot be used instead, and cross-documents must be grouped according to currency. The FC column of the local currency document may not be applicable, and the business amount cannot be determined to be zero due to zero or null values. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

GTotalSC.displayName: Total Line Tax Including Tax (System Currency)
GTotalSC.description: document line is the tax-included total after taking line discounts into account, and is used separately from the tax-exclusive LineTotal series; it is not presumed that all header discounts, fees or prepayments have been allocated, nor is it directly equivalent to the total document header total. currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, using the saved amount and not recalculating according to the current exchange rate. InvQty.description: The quantity represented by inventory unit of measure; unlike Quantity, whether an inventory movement is formed is still determined by the document and mark.

ItemCode.description: Material identification; identical materials cannot be proven to belong to the same order, work order, or source line.

LineNum.description: Participates in the composite primary key and BaseLine source connection; not the interface sort number VisOrder. Line numbers need not be contiguous and cannot be reconstructed from API collection array indexes.

LineStatus.description: O=Open; C=Close. Closing and canceling have different meanings; they are handled explicitly based on business issues, and valid and canceled documents cannot be mixed.

NoInvtryMv.description: There is no inventory quantity change flag, and the presence of the field does not mean that this type of document will necessarily cause inventory movement. NumPerMsr.description: The unit of measure conversion value saved in this document line; historical analysis must not be directly overwritten with the current material master data conversion.

ObjType.description: The object type belonging to the current document cannot replace the BaseType explanation source.

OpenInvQty.description: Quantity of open expressed as inventory UoM; used for comparison with basis in stock, still in current status.

OpenQty.description: The current remaining quantity of open; it is not the balance at any historical point in time, nor can it be generally equal to the quantity that has not been shipped or invoiced.

The same shared type maps to different tables under other parent documents. document line granularity, primary key (DocEntry, LineNum). A/R offset document; can be based on returns, invoices, prepayments or return requests, quantity and inventory effects must be evaluated using the source and flags. Amount basis: LineTotal is local currency line amount excluding tax, currency is the company database OADM local currency (OADM.MainCurncy); TotalSumSy is system currency line amount, currency is OADM.SysCurrncy; foreign currency document TotalFrgn uses header DocCur (ORIN.DocCur), and ORIN.DocEntry is related to this line DocEntry. this line Currency is the price currency, not the unified currency for all line amount. The amounts across currency foreign currency are summarized separately; the total amount in the first section cannot be directly equivalent to line amount excluding tax. For service lines, current open amounts are OpenSum/OpenSumFC/OpenSumSys. TreeType identifies BOM roles. Use the project and sales employee saved on the line, without substituting header or current master values.

AcctCode.description: document line account code, associated with OACT.AcctCode; the service line can explain the business through the account and description. The presence of an account code does not prove that the document has generated accounting postings or that the amount has been recognized as revenue.

BaseEntry.description: Marketing document source internal key; target DocEntry is joined only if the source type matches.

BaseLine.description: Marketing document source line number; forms a source triplet with BaseEntry and BaseType. References the stored LineNum of the source document, not the source collection API array index or UI display order.

BaseType.description: Only the this line direct source type is recorded; it must be connected together with BaseEntry and BaseLine, and the direct edge cannot be made according to the flow chart. SQL predicates use the source object type numeric code, never an API entity name; supported direct sources follow the declared relationships.

Currency.description: currency for this line price is used to interpret price fields such as Price; it cannot be used to interpret LineTotal or TotalSumSy, which use OADM.MainCurncy and OADM.SysCurrncy respectively. foreign currency document line amount TotalFrgn is explained by ORIN.DocCur, line price currency and document currency must be read separately.

DiscPrcnt.description: The current discount percentage of document line is separate from the entire order discount.

DocDate.description: Business posting date; used with document date, due date and creation date respectively.

DocEntry.description: The internal key of the corresponding table header; and LineNum constitute the primary key of this table row.

Dscription.description: The material or service description saved by document line reflects the historical content of the document and cannot be replaced by the current material master data name; the service line belonging to ORIN.DocType=S does not have ItemCode.

FreeTxt.description: document line Free text or remarks.

GrossBuyPr.description: The base price used to calculate this line gross profit can be taken from the price list, latest purchase price, material cost, etc. based on gross profit settings. It is not a fixed actual purchase cost, nor can it be directly regarded as the inventory delivery cost; currency and the pricing unit need to be verified with applicable documents and settings.

GTotal.displayName: Total Line Tax Including Tax (Local Currency)
GTotal.description: document line is the tax-included total after taking line discounts into account, and is used separately from the tax-exclusive LineTotal series; it is not presumed that all header discounts, fees or prepayments have been allocated, nor is it directly equivalent to the total document header total. currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy. Do not press DocCur or line Currency to assign currency to this column. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

GTotalFC.displayName: Total Line Tax Including Tax (Foreign Currency)
GTotalFC.description: document line is the tax-included total after taking line discounts into account, and is used separately from the tax-exclusive LineTotal series; it is not presumed that all header discounts, fees or prepayments have been allocated, nor is it directly equivalent to the total document header total. Normal foreign currency documents interpret currency according to the ORIN.DocCur they belong to. This mapping is a combined interpretation of the field family and the document currency rules; the line price Currency cannot be used instead, and cross-documents must be grouped according to currency. The FC column of the local currency document may not be applicable, and the business amount cannot be determined to be zero due to zero or null values. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

GTotalSC.displayName: Total Line Tax Including Tax (System Currency)
GTotalSC.description: document line is the tax-included total after taking line discounts into account, and is used separately from the tax-exclusive LineTotal series; it is not presumed that all header discounts, fees or prepayments have been allocated, nor is it directly equivalent to the total document header total. currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, using the saved amount and not recalculating according to the current exchange rate. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

InvQty.description: The quantity represented by inventory unit of measure; unlike Quantity, whether an inventory movement is formed is still determined by the document and mark.

ItemCode.description: Material identification; identical materials cannot be proven to belong to the same order, work order, or source line.

LineNum.description: Participates in the composite primary key and BaseLine source connection; not the interface sort number VisOrder. Line numbers need not be contiguous and cannot be reconstructed from API collection array indexes.

LineStatus.description: O=Open; C=Close. Closing and canceling have different meanings; they are handled explicitly based on business issues, and valid and canceled documents cannot be mixed.

LineTotal.description: Excluding tax local currency line amount, currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy; does not change the Currency or header DocCur to currency basis. It is not equal to the posted amount of inventory valuation, nor can it be directly equal to the total amount of the document header, ignoring taxes, discounts and rounding differences.

NoInvtryMv.description: No quantity posting flag for the receivable credit line; Y means this line does not change the inventory quantity. The credit may only adjust the amount without physical returns. All credits Quantity cannot be regarded as the actual return amount; the inventory and accounting impact must still be judged based on the source documents and business conditions.

NumPerMsr.description: The unit of measure conversion value saved in this document line; historical analysis must not be directly overwritten with the current material master data conversion.

ObjType.description: The object type belonging to the current document cannot replace the BaseType explanation source.

OpenInvQty.description: Quantity of open expressed as inventory UoM; used for comparison with basis in stock, still in current status.

OpenQty.description: The current remaining quantity of open; it is not the balance at any historical point in time, nor can it be generally equal to the quantity that has not been shipped or invoiced.

Price.description: DI API defines Price as the unit price before tax; the database reference in this table is only marked as price, and the meaning after discount must be interpreted in conjunction with PriceBefDi, DiscPrcnt and pricing rules. It cannot be claimed that this table dictionary has directly stated it. The price currency is taken from this line Currency, and is interpreted according to the this line transaction pricing unit; it is checked with UomEntry/UomCode/unitMsr, UseBaseUn and NumPerMsr, and is not priced according to inventory UoM by default. It is not directly added as the business amount, nor can it be used as the inventory valuation unit price.

PriceAfVAT.displayName: Unit Price Including Tax After Line Discount
PriceAfVAT.description: The tax-included unit price after applying this line discount is not the tax-included price before discount. The price currency is taken from this line Currency, and is interpreted according to the this line transaction pricing unit; it is checked with UomEntry/UomCode/unitMsr, UseBaseUn and NumPerMsr, and is not priced according to inventory UoM by default. It is used separately with the pre-tax price, pre-discount price and line amount, and does not overwrite the historical value with the current tax rate and discount recalculation.

PriceBefDi.displayName: Unit Price Before Discount And Tax
PriceBefDi.description: The pre-tax unit price before this line discount is applied; this table column definition and the SAP unit price rule jointly determine the basis. The price currency is taken from this line Currency, and is interpreted according to the this line transaction pricing unit; it is checked with UomEntry/UomCode/unitMsr, UseBaseUn and NumPerMsr, and is not priced according to inventory UoM by default. Use separately with the discounted price and saved line amount.

Quantity.description: The quantity of sales or purchasing units in a document; the unit must be unified before totaling across documents and materials, and is not directly equivalent to the inventory UoM quantity.

Rate.description: document line currency is converted to exchange rate for company local currency.

ShipDate.description: this line delivery date field; different from the header posting date, whether actual delivery must be combined with the document type.

TargetType.description: The object type of the subsequent target document.

TotalFrgn.description: foreign currency basis of line amount; foreign currency documents are interpreted by belonging to ORIN.DocCur, this line DocEntry is associated with ORIN.DocEntry, and cross-documents are grouped by DocCur. Row Currency only represents the price currency, and does not assign currency to this column accordingly; LineTotal is used for local currency documents, and the business amount is not judged to be zero based on the zero or empty value of this column.

TotalSumSy.description: system currency basis and currency of line amount take the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy; it is not the unit price, the row Currency or header DocCur is not used as currency, and the saved amount is not recalculated according to the current exchange rate.

unitMsr.description: this line unit of measure display name; used to explain Quantity.

UomCode.description: this line unit of measure code; different unit quantities cannot be added directly before consistency is verified.

UomEntry.description: this line unit of measure mark; should be used together with UomCode and the conversion value saved in the document.

UseBaseUn.description: this line inventory unit of measure mark; combined with Quantity, InvQty and unit code explanation.

VatSum.description: document line total tax, including standard tax and applicable equalization tax, can be manually adjusted; unlike LineVat series net tax, the saved value is not overwritten by the price multiplied by the tax rate. currency takes the same company database OADM.MainCurncy. Do not press DocCur or line Currency to assign currency to this column. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

VatSumFrgn.description: document line total tax, including standard tax and applicable equalization tax, can be manually adjusted; unlike LineVat series net tax, the saved value is not overwritten by the price multiplied by the tax rate. This mapping is a combined interpretation of the field family and the document currency rules; the line price Currency cannot be used instead, and cross-documents must be grouped according to currency. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

VatSumSy.description: document line total tax, including standard tax and applicable equalization tax, can be manually adjusted; unlike LineVat series net tax, the saved value is not overwritten by the price multiplied by the tax rate. currency takes the same company database OADM.SysCurrncy, and uses the saved amount, and does not recalculate according to the current exchange rate. Summarize by row granularity of DocEntry, LineNum to avoid double measurement of relationship expansion.

VisOrder.description: The display order of document line in the interface.

WhsCode.description: Business lines correspond to warehouses; warehouses, storage locations and materials have different granularities.

Project.description: Project code saved on this line; joins OPRJ.PrjCode. Do not default to the header project or remove historical lines based on current project activity or validity. Distinguish an empty code from an unmatched project master record.

SlpCode.description: Sales employee code saved on this line; joins OSLP.SlpCode. Keep it separate from the header sales employee and the current customer master salesperson; do not force them to agree. Null, unassigned and unmatched values do not identify a default employee.

TreeType.description: Document line BOM role: N=not a BOM, A=assembly, S=sales BOM, I=sales BOM component, P=production BOM, T=template. OpenSumFC.description: Only applicable to service document lines with parent ORIN.DocType=S. Verify foreign-currency applicability and currency against the parent document, not the line price Currency; aggregate different currencies separately.

OpenSumSys.description: Only applicable to service document lines with parent ORIN.DocType=S. rin11.displayName: A/R Credit Memo Down Payment Draw Detail

The foreign currency deduction amount must be verified by combining the corresponding documents, source prepayment documents and currency; this template has not yet confirmed the ownership of currency in all cross-currency deduction situations, and will not automatically infer based on field suffixes or adjacent documents. LineNum.description: The deduction record is line number; it cannot be regarded as the material detail line number.

LineType.description: D=document line, R=currency rounding, H=prepayment document rounding; the rounding type needs to be retained in summary.

ObjType.description: The object type of the current invoice or credit to which this detail belongs.

BaseEntry.description: Marketing document source internal key; target DocEntry is joined only if the source type matches.

BaseType.description: Only the this line direct source type is recorded; it must be connected together with BaseEntry and BaseLine, and the direct edge cannot be made according to the flow chart.

DiscPrcnt.description: The current discount percentage of document line is separate from the entire order discount.
